domains.name: content
domains.description: Single source of truth for all content assets across the enterprise — covering titles, episodes, series, films, clips, music, news segments, and live events. Manages content metadata (EIDR, ISAN, ISRC identifiers), format specifications, versioning, localization, MPA ratings, genre classification, and content lifecycle from acquisition through archival. Serves as the master catalog referenced by scheduling, distribution, rights, and digital asset domains.

products.name: title
products.description: Master catalog record for every content asset across the enterprise — films, series, episodes, clips, music tracks, news segments, and live events. Serves as the authoritative SSOT for content identity, carrying EIDR, ISAN, and ISRC identifiers, MPA content rating, genre classification, original language, country of origin, production year, content type discriminator (film/series/episode/clip/music/news/live), runtime in seconds, content status (active/archived/restricted), parental advisory flags, COPPA child-directed flag, and lifecycle timestamps. Acts as the universal join point referenced by scheduling, distribution, rights, digital asset, and advertising domains. Format-level technical specifications are managed by the version and digital asset domains.

products.name: genre
products.description: Enterprise reference taxonomy for content genre and sub-genre classification. Captures genre code, genre name, parent genre reference (enabling hierarchical sub-genres like Drama > Legal Drama), genre tier (primary/secondary), applicable content types, IAB content category mapping for ad targeting, and active status. Standardizes genre labeling across EPG systems, streaming platform metadata feeds, and advertising contextual targeting to ensure consistent audience segmentation and content discovery.
products.reference: IAB Content Taxonomy / TV Parental Guidelines

attributes.name: genre_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the genre. Primary key for the genre reference taxonomy.

attributes.name: parent_genre_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent genre in the hierarchical taxonomy, enabling multi-level classification such as Drama > Legal Drama or Sports > Football. Null for top-level genres.

attributes.name: ad_pod_compatibility
attributes.description: Indicates whether content in this genre is compatible with Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) and ad pod placement. False for genres requiring uninterrupted viewing (e.g., live sports critical moments, news breaking coverage).

attributes.business_glossary_term: Advertising-Supported Video On Demand (AVOD) Monetization Potential
attributes.description: Revenue generation potential for this genre on Advertising-Supported Video On Demand (AVOD) platforms, based on Cost Per Mille (CPM) rates and advertiser demand. High-potential genres command premium ad rates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this genre record was first created in the enterprise content taxonomy system.

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: eidr_genre_mapping
attributes.description: Mapping to Entertainment Identifier Registry (EIDR) genre taxonomy for cross-industry content identification and rights management interoperability.

attributes.description: Indicates whether this genre is suitable for Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television (FAST) linear channel programming. FAST channels require genres with deep catalog availability and consistent audience appeal.

attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the genre for system integration and Electronic Program Guide (EPG) feeds. Used as a business key across scheduling, distribution, and metadata systems.

attributes.name: genre_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the genre, including defining characteristics, typical content examples, and audience expectations. Used for editorial guidance and content acquisition briefings.

attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the genre within the taxonomy. Primary represents top-level genres, secondary represents sub-genres, and tertiary represents granular classifications.

attributes.description: Indicates whether content in this genre is subject to geographic blackout restrictions or regional licensing constraints. Common for sports genres with territorial rights and retransmission consent agreements.

attributes.description: Indicates whether this genre is suitable for traditional linear scheduled broadcasting. Some genres (e.g., interactive, choose-your-own-adventure) are non-linear only.

attributes.description: Priority level for content localization (dubbing, subtitling, cultural adaptation) for this genre. High-priority genres justify investment in multi-language versions for international distribution.

attributes.description: Priority level for metadata enrichment and tagging in Media Asset Management (MAM) systems. Critical genres require comprehensive metadata for content discovery and personalization.

attributes.name: residuals_obligation_flag

attributes.name: royalty_rate_percent

attributes.name: runs_allowed

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX Section 302/404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: budget_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this budget record within the production finance system. Used for cross-system reference and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Center / WBS Element Coding

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Free-text narrative explaining the business justification for a budget revision (e.g., 'Schedule extension due to weather delays', 'Additional VFX shots approved by director'). Mandatory for revised versions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Budget Change Request; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: change_request_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the formal budget change request (BCR) document that authorized a revision to this budget line, traceable in the production finance approval workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Budget Change Request; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: Total value of open purchase order commitments (obligations) for this cost category that have been raised but not yet invoiced. Represents encumbered funds in the SAP MM/CO commitment ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Commitment Management; SAP MM Purchase Orders

attributes.name: contingency_amount
attributes.description: The absolute monetary value of the contingency reserve allocated for this cost category, derived from the contingency percentage applied to the approved budget amount.
attributes.references: MPA Production Cost Standards; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: contingency_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the approved budget allocated as contingency reserve for this cost category, representing the risk buffer approved by the production finance committee.
attributes.references: MPA Production Cost Standards; Production Finance Best Practice

attributes.name: cost_category_code
attributes.description: SAP cost element or cost category code classifying the type of production expenditure (e.g., ATL-TALENT, BTL-CREW, BTL-EQUIPMENT, POST-VFX, POST-AUDIO). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ATL-TALENT|ATL-RIGHTS|BTL-CREW|BTL-EQUIPMENT|BTL-FACILITIES|BTL-TRAVEL|POST-VFX|POST-AUDIO|POST-COLOR|CONTINGENCY — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Element; Motion Picture Association (MPA) Production Cost Standards

attributes.name: cost_category_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the production cost category (e.g., 'Above-the-Line Talent', 'Below-the-Line Crew', 'Visual Effects', 'Audio Post-Production').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Element Description; MPA Production Cost Standards

attributes.name: cost_line_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the cost line distinguishing above-the-line (ATL) creative costs (writers, directors, producers, talent) from below-the-line (BTL) technical and crew costs, post-production, contingency, and overhead.
attributes.references: MPA Production Cost Standards; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget record was first created in the source system or ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX Section 302/404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this budget record are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert this budget record's currency to the production's reporting currency at the time of budget approval or revision.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Exchange Rate Table; ISO 4217

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month number 1–12 or 1–16 for special periods) within the fiscal year to which this budget line is assigned in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Fiscal Period

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The four-digit fiscal year to which this budget record belongs in the SAP S/4HANA CO controlling area, used for annual financial planning and SOX reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Fiscal Year; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: forecast_amount
attributes.description: Latest estimate of the total cost expected to be incurred for this cost category by production completion, incorporating actuals to date and projected remaining spend.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Forecast; Production Finance Best Practice

attributes.name: is_greenlight_budget
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget record represents the original greenlight-approved budget for the production, as distinct from subsequent revisions. The greenlight budget is the primary financial authorization baseline.
attributes.references: MPA Production Cost Standards; Production Finance Best Practice

attributes.name: is_locked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget version has been locked and is no longer open for modification. A locked budget serves as the immutable financial baseline for variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Budget Lock; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, assumptions, or clarifications associated with this budget record, entered by the production finance team.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Long Text; Production Finance Best Practice

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the fiscal or production period covered by this budget record. Defines the temporal boundary for cost accumulation and variance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Fiscal Year Period; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the fiscal or production period covered by this budget record, aligning to the SAP fiscal year/period structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Fiscal Year Period; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: production_phase
attributes.description: The production lifecycle phase to which this budget line is attributed (e.g., Development, Pre-Production, Principal Photography, Post-Production, Delivery). Enables phase-level budget tracking.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Workflow Orchestration; MPA Production Cost Standards

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the group reporting currency to which all amounts are translated for consolidated financial reporting (e.g., USD for a US-headquartered broadcaster).
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA CO-PA; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: revised_amount
attributes.description: The most recently revised budget amount for this cost category following a formal budget change request. Null if no revision has been approved since the original budget.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Revised Plan Cost; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: sap_cost_object_code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA CO cost object identifier (Internal Order number or WBS Element ID) that anchors this budget record to the controlling module for financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Internal Order / WBS Element

attributes.name: sap_wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP Project System Work Breakdown Structure element code that maps this budget line to a specific phase or deliverable within the production project hierarchy (e.g., PRE-PROD, PRINCIPAL, POST-PROD).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module — WBS Element; SAP CO-PA

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this budget record was sourced (SAP S/4HANA CO for financial data, Dalet Galaxy for workflow-linked cost data, or MANUAL for spreadsheet-originated entries).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; Dalet Galaxy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this budget record in the source system or Silver Layer. Used for incremental load detection and change data capture.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX Section 302/404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between the approved (or revised) budget amount and the sum of actual costs plus commitments. A negative value indicates an over-budget condition; positive indicates underspend.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Variance Analysis; SOX Section 302/404; EBITDA Reporting

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version label of this budget record, distinguishing the original greenlight budget from subsequent revisions and the locked final version. Supports budget version history tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Plan Version

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential integer version number of this budget record (e.g., 1 = original, 2 = first revision). Enables ordered version history and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Plan Version

products.name: budget_line
products.description: Individual line-item within a production budget, representing a specific cost category or account code (e.g., cast fees, location fees, equipment rental, VFX, music licensing, post-production labor). Captures account code, cost category, sub-category, vendor or payee, budgeted amount, committed amount, actual amount, episode or segment allocation, and SAP G/L account reference. Enables granular cost tracking and variance analysis at the line-item level.

attributes.name: budget_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual budget line item within a production budget. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent production budget document that contains this line item. A production may have multiple budget versions (e.g., greenlight, revised, final).

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id

attributes.name: contract_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Individual budget line items must post to cost centers for detailed expense tracking and actuals vs. budget variance reporting. Required for monthly financial close and departmental budget management.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: When production costs are incurred, journal entries are posted against budget lines for accrual accounting and cost commitment tracking. Production accountants reconcile budget lines against journal e

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor, supplier, or payee associated with this budget line item (e.g., VFX house, location owner, equipment rental company, music licensor).

attributes.name: production_episode_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_episode. Business justification: budget_line already has a cross-domain content_episode_id but lacks an in-domain production_episode_id. Budget lines are frequently allocated at the episode level (e.g., VFX costs per episode, directo

attributes.name: production_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent production project to which this budget line belongs. Links the line item to its overarching production context.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Compliance cost tracking: budget lines for closed captioning, accessibility, or FCC filing fees must be traceable to the specific regulatory obligation driving the expenditure. Media broadcasting fina

attributes.name: royalty_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rights.royalty_rule. Business justification: Production accountants budget royalty and residual obligations per budget line using specific royalty rules. This link enables accurate royalty accrual forecasting during production budgeting. No exis

attributes.name: shoot_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.shoot_schedule. Business justification: budget_line has shoot_date_start and shoot_date_end as free-text date fields, indicating budget lines are tied to specific shoot periods. Adding shoot_schedule_id normalizes this to a proper FK relati

attributes.name: account_code
attributes.description: Industry-standard production account code identifying the cost category within the budget (e.g., 1100 for Above-the-Line Talent, 2200 for Camera Equipment). Follows standard production accounting chart of accounts (e.g., AICP, Producers Guild).
attributes.references: AICP (Association of Independent Commercial Producers) Standard Budget Format; SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: accrued_amount
attributes.description: Costs accrued for work performed or services received but not yet invoiced or formally committed. Supports period-end financial close and accurate cost-to-complete reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accrual Engine; GAAP ASC 420 / IAS 37 Accruals

attributes.name: actual_amount
attributes.description: Total actual costs incurred and posted against this budget line to date, sourced from SAP FI invoice postings and payroll actuals. Used for variance analysis against budgeted and committed amounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Actual Cost Posting; GAAP Accrual Accounting

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this budget line was formally approved by the authorized approver. Provides an audit trail for financial governance and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Workflow Audit Trail

attributes.name: budgeted_amount
attributes.description: Original approved budget amount for this line item as established at greenlight or budget approval. Represents the planned cost baseline against which actuals and commitments are measured.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Original Budget; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: Total value of purchase orders, contracts, or binding agreements raised against this budget line but not yet invoiced. Represents financial obligations that reduce available budget.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Commitment Management; GAAP Commitment Accounting

attributes.name: contingency_pct
attributes.description: Contingency percentage applied to this budget line to cover unforeseen cost overruns. Typically 5–15% for production lines. Contributes to the overall production contingency reserve.
attributes.references: AICP Standard Budget Format; PMI PMBOK Contingency Reserve

attributes.name: cost_category
attributes.description: High-level cost category classifying the budget line within the production budget structure. Above-the-line covers creative talent (writers, directors, producers, cast); below-the-line covers crew, equipment, locations, and production services. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: above_the_line|below_the_line|post_production|music_licensing|vfx|marketing|overhead|contingency|insurance|legal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AICP Standard Budget Format; Motion Picture Association (MPA) Production Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: cost_sub_category
attributes.description: Granular sub-classification within the cost category (e.g., 'Cast Fees', 'Location Fees', 'Equipment Rental', 'VFX Compositing', 'Music Synchronization License', 'Post-Production Labor'). Enables detailed variance analysis at the sub-category level.
attributes.references: AICP Standard Budget Format; SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Element

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this budget line record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for record provenance and financial governance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; SAP S/4HANA Change Document

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this budget line (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency production budgets for international co-productions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Multi-Currency Accounting

attributes.name: forecast_amount
attributes.description: Estimate at Completion (EAC) for this budget line, representing the current best estimate of total cost when the line item is fully complete. Combines actuals to date with estimate to complete.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PS Estimate at Completion; PMI PMBOK Earned Value Management

attributes.name: fringe_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage applied to labor costs on this line to account for employer fringe benefits (payroll taxes, pension contributions, health insurance, residuals). Standard production accounting practice for above-the-line and below-the-line labor lines.
attributes.references: AICP Standard Budget Format; SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll Fringe Calculation; Residuals (Talent Reuse Payments) — DGA, SAG-AFTRA, WGA Collective Bargaining Agreements

attributes.name: is_above_the_line
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this budget line is classified as above-the-line (ATL) cost, covering creative talent such as writers, directors, producers, and principal cast. False indicates below-the-line (BTL) cost.
attributes.references: AICP Standard Budget Format; Motion Picture Association (MPA) Production Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: is_union_labor
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this budget line involves union or guild labor subject to collective bargaining agreements (DGA, SAG-AFTRA, WGA, IATSE). Drives fringe rate calculations and residuals obligations.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA; DGA (Directors Guild of America); WGA (Writers Guild of America); IATSE Collective Bargaining Agreements

attributes.name: line_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific cost item represented by this budget line (e.g., 'Lead Actor Day Rate — Week 3', 'Steadicam Rental — Principal Photography', 'Dolby Atmos Mix — Episode 4').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Budget Line Item Description

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the parent budget document, used for ordering and referencing individual line items in budget reports and purchase orders.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Budget Line Item

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget line item, tracking its progression from initial draft through approval, commitment, invoicing, and payment. Drives workflow routing and financial reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|approved|committed|invoiced|paid|cancelled|on_hold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Budget Execution; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the production accountant or line producer providing additional context, assumptions, or justification for this budget line item.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Budget Line Item Notes

attributes.name: production_phase
attributes.description: Phase of the production workflow during which this cost is incurred. Enables phase-based cost tracking and cash flow forecasting across the full production lifecycle from development through delivery.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Workflow Orchestration; Motion Picture Association (MPA) Production Lifecycle

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP purchase order number raised against this budget line for vendor commitments. Links the budget line to the formal procurement document and enables three-way matching (PO, goods receipt, invoice).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-PUR Purchase Order; SOX Section 404 Procurement Controls

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of units associated with this budget line (e.g., number of shoot days, number of crew members, number of VFX shots, hours of post-production labor). Combined with unit_rate to derive budgeted amount.
attributes.references: AICP Standard Budget Format; SAP S/4HANA CO Quantity-Based Costing

attributes.name: revised_budgeted_amount
attributes.description: Most recent approved revision to the budgeted amount, reflecting approved change orders, scope changes, or budget transfers. Null if no revision has been approved since original budget.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Budget Supplement/Return; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: tax_credit_eligible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this budget line qualifies for production tax credits or incentives (e.g., UK High-End TV Tax Relief, US state film tax credits). Enables automated calculation of eligible spend for tax credit claims.
attributes.references: Ofcom (UK) High-End TV Tax Relief; FCC Production Incentive Reporting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity field (e.g., day, hour, week, flat_fee, shot, reel, license). Defines how the quantity is counted for rate-based cost calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: day|hour|week|flat_fee|shot|reel|license|unit — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AICP Standard Budget Format; SAP S/4HANA Unit of Measure

attributes.name: unit_rate
attributes.description: Rate per unit of measure for this budget line (e.g., daily rate for a crew member, hourly rate for facility hire, per-shot rate for VFX). Multiplied by quantity to derive the budgeted amount.
attributes.references: AICP Standard Budget Format; SAP S/4HANA CO Activity Rate

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this budget line record was most recently modified. Supports incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer and change data capture from SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; SAP S/4HANA Change Document; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP Work Breakdown Structure element code that hierarchically positions this budget line within the production project plan (e.g., PRD-2024-001.3.2.1 for a specific post-production task).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS (Project System); PMI PMBOK Work Breakdown Structure

products.name: crew_assignment

References the talent domain for the crew members master record. Tracks the full below-the-line crew roster for a production.

attributes.name: crew_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a crew assignment record in the production domain. Primary key for the crew_assignment data product.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_episode. Business justification: Crew can be assigned to specific episodes within a series production. Optional FK (nullable) — crew may be assigned at project level or episode level. Enables episode-specific crew tracking for episod

attributes.description: Reference to the production project to which this crew member is assigned. Links the assignment to the master production record.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.program_rundown. Live broadcast operations teams manage crew-to-ru

attributes.name: talent_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the crew member's master record in the talent domain. Identifies the individual below-the-line crew member being assigned.

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this crew assignment, used in deal memos, call sheets, and payroll processing. Format: CA-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the crew assignment. Drives payroll eligibility, call sheet inclusion, and production roster reporting. attributes.name: box_rental_rate
attributes.description: Daily or weekly rate paid to the crew member for the rental of their personal tool box or specialized equipment package (e.g., makeup artist's kit, wardrobe supervisor's supplies). Distinct from kit_rental_rate which covers technical equipment.
attributes.references: IATSE Basic Agreement — Box Rental Provisions; SAP S/4HANA FI — Vendor Payment

attributes.name: contracted_rate
attributes.description: The agreed compensation rate for this crew assignment, expressed in the applicable deal_type unit (per day, per week, or flat total). Stored in the production's base currency. Used for budget tracking and payroll processing in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: credit_name

attributes.name: credit_position

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: dalet_workflow_reference
attributes.description: The workflow instance identifier in Dalet Galaxy that corresponds to this crew assignment's production workflow. Enables traceability between the HR/payroll record and the media asset management workflow orchestration system.

attributes.name: department

Drives crew call sheet grouping and budget cost center allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: camera|grip|electric|art|wardrobe|hair_makeup|post_production|sound|vfx|production — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATSE Department Classifications; SAP S/4HANA CO — Cost Center Structure

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: guaranteed_days

attributes.references: DGA Basic Agreement — Guaranteed Employment; IATSE Basic Agreement — Minimum Guarantee

attributes.name: kit_rental_rate
attributes.description: Daily or weekly rate paid to the crew member for the rental of their personal professional equipment (kit) used on the production (e.g., camera operator's lens kit, sound mixer's equipment package). Common in below-the-line crew deals.
attributes.references: IATSE Basic Agreement — Kit Rental Provisions; SAP S/4HANA FI — Vendor Payment

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this crew assignment record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trail, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability; SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: meal_penalty_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crew member is entitled to meal penalty payments if the production fails to provide a meal break within the contractually required interval (typically 6 hours under IATSE/DGA agreements). Drives production scheduling compliance.
attributes.references: IATSE Basic Agreement — Meal Period Provisions; DGA Basic Agreement — Meal Penalties

attributes.name: overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crew member is eligible for overtime pay under their union/guild agreement or applicable labor law. True = eligible for overtime; False = flat deal or exempt classification. Drives payroll calculation logic.
attributes.references: IATSE Basic Agreement — Overtime Provisions; DGA Basic Agreement; US Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

attributes.name: overtime_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: The multiplier applied to the base contracted_rate for overtime hours (e.g., 1.5 for time-and-a-half, 2.0 for double-time). Applicable only when overtime_eligible is True. Sourced from the applicable union/guild agreement.
attributes.references: IATSE Basic Agreement — Overtime Rate Schedule; DGA Basic Agreement; US Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

attributes.name: per_diem_rate
attributes.description: Daily allowance paid to the crew member for meals and incidental expenses when working away from their home base location. Rate varies by filming location and union agreement. Used for production cost budgeting.
attributes.references: IATSE Basic Agreement — Per Diem; DGA Basic Agreement — Living Allowance; US GSA Per Diem Rates

attributes.name: production_company
attributes.description: The legal name of the production company or entity that is the employer of record for this crew assignment. Relevant for co-productions where multiple entities may employ different crew members. Used for payroll and tax reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Company Code; SOX Financial Reporting; IRS Form W-2/1099 Reporting

attributes.name: residuals_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crew member is entitled to residual payments when the production is reused, syndicated, or distributed on additional platforms (e.g., streaming, international broadcast). Residuals are governed by DGA, IATSE, and SAG-AFTRA agreements.
attributes.references: DGA Basic Agreement — Residuals; IATSE Basic Agreement — Residuals; SAG-AFTRA Residuals Schedule; Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management

attributes.name: role_title
attributes.description: The specific production role or job title assigned to the crew member (e.g., Director, Director of Photography, Gaffer, Script Supervisor, Editor, Colorist, VFX Supervisor, Sound Mixer, Key Grip, Best Boy). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: director|director_of_photography|gaffer|script_supervisor|editor|colorist|vfx_supervisor|sound_mixer|key_grip|best_boy|production_designer|costume_designer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DGA (Directors Guild of America) Classification; IATSE (International Alliance of Theatrical Stage Employees) Job Classifications; SAG-AFTRA Crew Definitions

attributes.name: safety_training_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the crew member has completed the required on-set safety training certification for this production (e.g., OSHA safety, COVID-19 protocols, stunt safety). Required for insurance compliance and production liability management.
attributes.references: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) Standards; IATSE Safety Bulletins; Production Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: sap_personnel_action_code
attributes.description: The personnel action number in SAP S/4HANA HR that corresponds to this crew assignment. Used for payroll processing, benefits enrollment, and HR compliance reporting. Enables reconciliation between the production data product and the ERP system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module — Personnel Action (Infotype 0000); SOX Financial Reporting Compliance

attributes.name: scheduled_days
attributes.description: The total number of work days currently scheduled for this crew member on the production, as reflected in the current production schedule. May differ from guaranteed_days if the schedule changes.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Workflow Orchestration — Production Schedule; SAP S/4HANA PM — Work Order Scheduling

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The contractually agreed first day of work for this crew assignment. Used for payroll calculation, permit verification, and production schedule alignment.
attributes.references: DGA Basic Agreement; IATSE Basic Agreement; SAG-AFTRA Crew Contracts

attributes.name: travel_allowance
attributes.description: Fixed or estimated travel reimbursement amount for this crew assignment, covering transportation costs to and from the filming location. Distinct from per_diem_rate which covers daily living expenses.
attributes.references: IATSE Basic Agreement — Travel Provisions; DGA Basic Agreement — Travel; SAP S/4HANA FI — Expense Management

attributes.name: turnaround_hours
attributes.description: The minimum number of hours required between the end of one work day and the start of the next for this crew member, as stipulated by their union/guild agreement (e.g., 10 hours for IATSE, 12 hours for DGA). Violation triggers turnaround penalty payments.
attributes.references: IATSE Basic Agreement — Rest Period; DGA Basic Agreement — Turnaround; SAG-AFTRA Turnaround Provisions

attributes.name: work_permit_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the crew member's work permit or visa authorization. Used to trigger renewal alerts and ensure continuous legal work authorization throughout the assignment period.
attributes.references: US Immigration and Nationality Act; UK Visas and Immigration; Ofcom Compliance

attributes.name: work_permit_number
attributes.description: The official government-issued work permit or visa authorization number for the crew member in the production jurisdiction. Nullable when work_permit_required is False. Required for compliance audits and production insurance.
attributes.references: US Immigration and Nationality Act; UK Visas and Immigration; GDPR Article 9 — Special Category Data

attributes.name: work_permit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a work permit or visa authorization is required for this crew member to legally work on this production in the filming jurisdiction. True = permit required; False = no permit required (domestic/citizen crew). Triggers compliance workflow in HR.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Licensing; Ofcom Broadcasting Standards; US Immigration and Nationality Act; UK Visas and Immigration

products.name: facility_booking
products.description: Reservation and usage record for a production facility — soundstage, editing suite, dubbing stage, color grading suite, ADR studio, screening room, or post-production bay. Captures facility name, facility type, location, booking start datetime, booking end datetime, booked production project, booked episode or segment, booking status (tentative, confirmed, cancelled), rate per hour or day, total cost, and technical specifications of the facility. Enables resource conflict detection and cost allocation.

attributes.name: facility_booking_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each facility booking record in the production domain. Primary key for the facility_booking data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Facility bookings must be assigned to cost centers for facility cost allocation and chargeback to production departments. Replaces denormalized cost_center_code. Required for studio utilization report

attributes.description: Identifier of the external facility vendor or studio lot operator when the booked facility is not company-owned. References the vendor master in SAP S/4HANA for procurement and payment processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Internal Vendor Management Standard

attributes.name: production_episode_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_episode. Facility bookings (editing suites, dubbing stages) are frequently tied to specific producti

attributes.name: production_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the production project for which this facility is being booked. Links the booking to the overarching content production initiative.

attributes.name: program_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.program_schedule. Business justification: Studio and facility bookings are made to support specific program schedules (e.g., a studio booked for a live weekly show's broadcast schedule). Facility managers and production coordinators track boo

attributes.name: shoot_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.shoot_schedule. Business justification: Facility bookings are made for specific shoot schedule entries. Operational link — booking times align with shoot schedule. Optional FK (nullable) — facilities may also be booked for post-production o

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: The final invoiced or accrued cost of the facility booking after actual usage is confirmed. Includes any overtime charges or adjustments. Reconciled against estimated_cost for budget variance reporting in SAP S/4HANA CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; SOX; Internal Production Finance Standard

attributes.name: actual_end
attributes.description: The actual date and time the facility usage concluded, as recorded by the facility operator or production coordinator. Used for overtime calculation, billing reconciliation, and schedule variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM; Internal Production Operations Standard

attributes.name: actual_start
attributes.description: The actual date and time the facility usage commenced, as recorded by the facility operator or production coordinator. May differ from booking_start due to delays or early starts. Used for variance analysis and billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM; Internal Production Operations Standard

attributes.name: booking_end
attributes.description: The scheduled date and time at which the facility booking period ends. Combined with booking_start to compute duration and detect scheduling conflicts across productions.

attributes.name: booking_reference
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric reference code assigned to this booking, used in communications with facility operators, vendors, and production coordinators. Corresponds to the booking order number in SAP S/4HANA MM module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Internal Booking Operations Standard

attributes.name: booking_start
attributes.description: The scheduled date and time at which the facility booking period begins. Used for conflict detection, crew scheduling, and playout coordination. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.

attributes.name: booking_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the facility booking. 'tentative' indicates a provisional hold pending confirmation; 'confirmed' indicates a firm reservation; 'cancelled' indicates the booking was withdrawn; 'completed' indicates the facility usage has concluded; 'on_hold' indicates a temporary pause pending decision.
attributes.references: Internal Production Workflow Standard; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the facility booking was formally cancelled. Used to determine whether cancellation fees apply per the vendor contract terms and for financial accrual reversal in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Internal Production Finance Standard

attributes.name: cancellation_fee
attributes.description: Monetary penalty charged by the facility vendor when a confirmed booking is cancelled within the contractual notice period. Recorded for financial reconciliation and budget variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Internal Production Finance Standard; SOX

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the booking was cancelled. Populated only when booking_status is 'cancelled'. Used for production post-mortem analysis and vendor dispute resolution.

attributes.name: capacity_persons
attributes.description: Maximum number of persons the facility can accommodate during the booking period. Used for crew planning, health and safety compliance, and resource allocation decisions.
attributes.references: Internal Facility Safety Standard; Ofcom; FCC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this facility booking record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker and is used for SLA compliance tracking and data lineage.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the rate and total cost are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-territory productions and financial reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: dalet_workflow_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the associated workflow job in Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management system. Enables traceability between the facility booking and the ingest, metadata, or archive workflow triggered by the production activity.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy MAM; Internal Digital Asset Management Standard

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: The projected total cost of the facility booking at the time of reservation, calculated from rate_amount and the planned booking duration. Used for production budget planning and greenlight approvals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Internal Production Budget Standard

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the production facility being booked. Drives resource conflict detection logic and cost allocation rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: soundstage|editing_suite|dubbing_stage|color_grading_suite|adr_studio|screening_room|post_production_bay — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SMPTE Facility Classification; Internal Production Operations Standard

attributes.name: is_exclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this booking grants exclusive use of the facility for the booked period, preventing any concurrent bookings by other productions. When False, the facility may be shared with other productions subject to capacity constraints.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for production coordinators to capture special requirements, setup instructions, access arrangements, or other operational notes relevant to the facility booking.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours the facility was used beyond the originally booked end time. Drives overtime rate calculations and is a key input to actual_cost reconciliation and production schedule variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM; Internal Production Operations Standard

attributes.name: production_phase
attributes.description: The stage of the content production lifecycle during which this facility is being used. Enables cost allocation by production phase and supports milestone tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pre_production|principal_photography|post_production|vfx|color_grading|audio_mix|delivery — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SMPTE Production Workflow Standard; Internal Production Management Standard

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA MM purchase order number raised for this facility booking when the facility is provided by an external vendor. Required for accounts payable processing and three-way match (PO, goods receipt, invoice).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; SOX; PCI DSS

attributes.name: rate_amount
attributes.description: The contracted rate charged for the facility per the applicable rate_type unit (e.g., cost per hour or cost per day). Sourced from the facility rate card or negotiated contract. Used for budget estimation and cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Internal Production Finance Standard

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: The billing rate structure applied to this facility booking. Determines how the total cost is calculated — per hour, per day, half-day block, weekly block, or a negotiated flat fee.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Internal Production Finance Standard

attributes.name: technical_specs
attributes.description: Free-text description of the technical capabilities and equipment configuration of the facility at the time of booking (e.g., 'Dolby Atmos 7.1.4 mixing console, Pro Tools HDX, 4K DI suite'). Sourced from Dalet Galaxy facility metadata.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy MAM; SMPTE Technical Standards; ATSC

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this facility booking record was most recently modified. Used for change detection in ETL pipelines, audit compliance, and conflict resolution in concurrent update scenarios.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Project System Work Breakdown Structure element code that identifies the specific production phase or deliverable to which this facility cost is charged. Enables granular project cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS; SOX; Internal Project Accounting Standard

Supports equipment cost tracking and loss/damage management.

attributes.name: equipment_allocation_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: equipment_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master equipment item record (camera body, lens, lighting rig, sound package, jib, drone, editing workstation, encoding hardware) being allocated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Equipment Master; Dalet Galaxy Asset Registry

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.location. Business justification: equipment_allocation has shoot_location as a free-text field. Adding location_id normalizes this to a proper FK relationship, enabling location-level equipment tracking (insurance requirements by loca

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the external rental vendor supplying the equipment. Null when the equipment is an owned asset. Used for vendor cost reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM (Materials Management) Vendor Master

attributes.name: production_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production project or title to which this equipment is allocated. Links the allocation to the broader production workflow managed in Dalet Galaxy.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling) WBS Element

attributes.name: shoot_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.shoot_schedule. Business justification: Equipment allocations are operationally tied to specific shoot days — cameras, lenses, and lighting rigs are checked out for particular shoot schedule entries. Adding shoot_schedule_id enables day-lev

attributes.name: allocation_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the equipment allocation ends — i.e., the last day the equipment is assigned to the production. Used for rental cost calculation and return scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM; Dalet Galaxy Scheduling

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the allocation record, used in production paperwork, crew call sheets, and facility booking confirmations. Format: EQALLOC-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.

attributes.name: allocation_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the equipment allocation begins — i.e., the first day the equipment is available to the production. Used for rental rate calculation and scheduling conflict detection.

attributes.name: allocation_status

attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Workflow Orchestration; SAP S/4HANA PM Maintenance Order Status

attributes.name: asset_tag_code
attributes.description: Internal asset tag or barcode label affixed to owned equipment for physical inventory tracking. Format: {CC}-{NNNNNN} where CC is category code. Null for rented equipment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Fixed Asset Management; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: checkout_condition

attributes.name: checkout_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time the equipment was physically checked out from the equipment room or rental house. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the allocation lifecycle.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the equipment allocation record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); SAP S/4HANA Audit Log

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the rental rate and insurance value amounts (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency productions and financial consolidation in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: dalet_workflow_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the associated Dalet Galaxy workflow instance that orchestrates the equipment allocation within the broader production ingest and post-production pipeline. Enables end-to-end workflow traceability.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management and Workflow Orchestration

attributes.name: damage_claim_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the damage or loss claim raised against this allocation, in the currency specified by currency_code. Null when no damage claim exists. Used for financial reconciliation and insurance recovery.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; SOX Financial Reporting; Production Insurance Standards

attributes.name: damage_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any damage, loss, or malfunction identified at return. Null when equipment is returned in acceptable condition. Used to support insurance claims and vendor dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Notification; Production Insurance Standards

attributes.name: equipment_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the equipment type being allocated. Drives cost centre coding, insurance grouping, and crew department assignment. attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Equipment Classification; ATSC Technical Standards

attributes.name: equipment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or model designation of the equipment item (e.g., ARRI ALEXA Mini LF, Cooke S4/i 32mm, Litepanels Astra 6X). Supports crew call sheets and production reports.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Asset Metadata; SAP S/4HANA PM Equipment Master

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the insurance policy covering this equipment allocation. Used for claims processing and compliance with production insurance requirements.

attributes.name: insurance_value
attributes.description: Declared replacement value of the equipment for insurance purposes, in the currency specified by currency_code. Used to calculate insurance premiums and process loss/damage claims.

attributes.name: is_insurance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether specific insurance coverage must be arranged for this equipment allocation (True) or whether it falls under the production's blanket policy (False). Relevant for high-value or specialist equipment.

attributes.name: is_owned_asset

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (Financial Accounting) Fixed Assets; IFRS 16 Leases

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes related to the equipment allocation, such as special handling instructions, configuration requirements, or crew briefing notes.

attributes.name: production_department
attributes.description: The production department responsible for the equipment allocation (e.g., camera, lighting, grip, sound). attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Centre; Production Industry Department Standards

attributes.name: quantity

attributes.name: rental_rate_amount

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing; IFRS 16 Leases; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: rental_rate_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rental rate is charged on a daily, weekly, or flat-fee basis. Determines how the total rental cost is computed for budget tracking and vendor invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: return_condition

attributes.name: return_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time the equipment was physically returned to the equipment room or rental house. Null until the equipment is returned. Used to calculate actual rental duration and late return penalties.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number of the specific equipment unit allocated. Used for asset tracking, insurance claims, and loss/damage investigations. Classified confidential as it identifies a specific high-value asset.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting; GDPR Article 5; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log

products.name: crew_call
products.description: This association product represents the day-specific assignment of a crew member to a shoot schedule day. It captures the operational reality of the Day Out of Days (DOOD) report and daily call sheet in film and television production. Each record links one crew assignment to one shoot schedule day with attributes that exist only in the context of that specific shoot day: individual call times, overtime triggers, meal penalty tracking, and turnaround compliance. This is a fundamental production management entity that cannot be modeled as attributes on either the crew assignment (which spans multiple shoot days) or the shoot schedule (which involves multiple crew members).. Existence Justification: In film and television production, crew assignments span multiple shoot days (e.g., a Director of Photography contracted for 45 shoot days), and each shoot day involves dozens of crew members across departments. The Day Out of Days (DOOD) report and daily call sheet are industry-standard production management documents that track the intersection of crew assignments and shoot schedule days. Each crew-day pairing has unique operational data: individual call times (hair/makeup called earlier than camera), overtime triggers, meal penalty tracking, and turnaround compliance—all of which cannot exist on either the crew assignment (which is multi-day) or the shoot schedule (which is multi-crew).

attributes.name: crew_call_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this crew call record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: crew_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the crew assignment record. Identifies which crew member assignment this call applies to.

attributes.name: shoot_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the shoot schedule day. Identifies which specific shoot day this crew call applies to.

attributes.name: actual_hours_worked
attributes.description: The actual number of hours this crew member worked on this shoot day, from their call time to their individual wrap time. Used for payroll calculation and overtime determination.

attributes.name: call_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this crew call: scheduled (on call sheet), confirmed (crew acknowledged), checked_in (crew arrived on set), wrapped (crew released), no_show (crew failed to appear), cancelled (shoot day cancelled or crew released before call).

attributes.name: call_time
attributes.description: The specific time this crew member is required to report to set for this shoot day. May differ from the general shoot schedule call time based on department needs (e.g., hair/makeup called earlier than camera crew).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this crew call record was first created in the system, typically when the call sheet is generated.

attributes.name: day_out_of_days_type
attributes.description: Industry-standard DOOD code indicating this crew members work status for this shoot day: SW (Start Work), W (Work), WF (Work Finish), SWF (Start Work Finish - one-day assignment), H (Hold - on call but not working), T (Travel), R (Rehearsal). This is the core attribute of the DOOD report.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this crew call record was most recently modified, tracking changes to call times, status, or actual hours.

attributes.name: meal_penalty_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crew member incurred a meal penalty on this shoot day due to failure to break within the contractually required window (typically 6 hours). Triggers additional compensation per union rules.

attributes.name: overtime_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specific crew member incurred overtime hours on this shoot day. Used for payroll processing and budget tracking. Derived from actual hours worked vs contracted hours.

attributes.name: travel_to_location_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crew member is required to travel to a distant location for this shoot day, triggering per diem and travel time compensation.

attributes.name: turnaround_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours between this crew members wrap time on the previous shoot day and their call time for this shoot day. Union agreements (DGA, IATSE, SAG-AFTRA) mandate minimum turnaround periods (typically 10-12 hours); violations trigger turnaround penalties.

attributes.name: wrap_time
attributes.description: The time this crew member was released from set for this shoot day. May differ from the general shoot schedule wrap time if certain departments wrap early or late.

attributes.description: The date on which this channel first went live and began broadcasting. Used for channel lifecycle tracking, anniversary reporting, regulatory licence history, and audience growth analytics.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Licence; Ofcom Broadcasting Licence; Internal Channel Master Record

attributes.name: logical_channel_number
attributes.description: The numeric channel position assigned to this channel in the Electronic Program Guide (EPG) and set-top box channel lineup. Used by MVPDs and vMVPDs for channel navigation and must-carry compliance reporting.
attributes.references: DVB Project Logical Channel Descriptor; ATSC A/65 PSIP Standard; MVPD Carriage Agreement

attributes.name: max_ad_load_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of total broadcast hour that may be allocated to advertising on this channel. Governs inventory capacity planning, FCC commercial limits compliance (children's programming), and upfront/scatter market sales commitments.
attributes.references: FCC Children's Television Act (47 CFR 73.670); IAB Ad Load Guidelines; Wide Orbit Inventory Management

attributes.name: mediafirst_channel_code
attributes.description: The channel identifier as configured in the Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation system. Used to link this master channel record to the playout engine for schedule execution, automation triggers, graphics insertion, and failover configuration.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Channel Management API; Internal Playout Operations Standard

attributes.name: mpeg_dash_stream_url
attributes.description: The MPEG-DASH (Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP) manifest URL for this channel's live stream, used for Android, Smart TV, and cross-platform OTT delivery via Akamai CDN.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 23009 MPEG-DASH; Akamai CDN Streaming; DVB-DASH

attributes.name: must_carry_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel is subject to must-carry obligations requiring MVPDs to include it in their channel lineup. Drives compliance reporting and carriage fee negotiations.
attributes.references: FCC Must-Carry Rules (47 CFR Part 76); Cable Television Consumer Protection and Competition Act 1992

attributes.name: network_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the broadcast network or channel brand (e.g., CNN, BBC One, ESPN). Used as the primary identity label for display in EPG, scheduling tools, and audience-facing interfaces.
attributes.references: Internal Channel Master; Ericsson MediaFirst Channel Configuration

attributes.name: nielsen_station_code
attributes.description: The unique station identifier assigned by Nielsen Media Research for audience measurement, ratings reporting, and GRP/TRP calculations. Links this channel to Nielsen ratings data for advertising sales and audience analytics.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; Nielsen Station Index; IAB Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: playout_automation_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the channel is configured for automated playout via Ericsson MediaFirst. When true, schedule execution, ad insertion cues, and failover are handled automatically. When false, manual playout operation is required.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Automation Configuration; Internal Broadcast Operations SLA

attributes.name: primary_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1/639-2 language code representing the primary audio language of the channel's programming (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish, 'fra' for French). Used for EPG metadata, accessibility compliance, and audience targeting.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; ISO 639-2 Language Codes; FCC Accessibility Requirements

attributes.name: retransmission_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this channel requires retransmission consent from MVPDs before rebroadcasting. Drives carriage fee negotiations and compliance with FCC retransmission consent rules.
attributes.references: FCC Retransmission Consent Rules (47 CFR 76.64); Cable Television Consumer Protection and Competition Act 1992

attributes.name: scte35_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether SCTE-35 digital program insertion cue markers are active on this channel for Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI). SCTE-35 signals define ad pod boundaries and splice points used by Wide Orbit traffic system and DAI platforms.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message Standard; IAB DAI Guidelines; Wide Orbit Traffic System Integration

attributes.name: transmission_standard
attributes.description: Technical broadcast transmission standard used to deliver the channel signal. ATSC and ATSC 3.0 apply to North American over-the-air broadcast; DVB-T/T2 and DVB-S/S2 apply to European terrestrial and satellite; QAM applies to cable distribution; IP applies to OTT/streaming delivery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ATSC|ATSC3|DVB-T|DVB-T2|DVB-S|DVB-S2|QAM|IP — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ATSC Standards A/53, A/322; DVB Project DVB-T2 EN 302 755; SCTE Standards; ISO/IEC 13818

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this channel record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: wide_orbit_station_code
attributes.description: The station code as configured in the Wide Orbit traffic and billing system. Used to link this channel master record to ad scheduling, sales orders, affidavit generation, and invoicing workflows in Wide Orbit.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Internal Ad Operations Integration Standard

products.name: daypart
products.description: Reference definition of named broadcast time segments (e.g., Early Morning, Morning Drive, Daytime, Prime Time, Late Fringe, Overnight) used to govern ad pricing, content scheduling, and audience targeting. Captures daypart code, start/end time boundaries, day-of-week applicability, audience demographic profile, and rate multiplier. Aligns with Nielsen daypart taxonomy and Wide Orbit traffic system.

attributes.name: daypart_id
attributes.description: Primary key for daypart

attributes.name: dai_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.dai_configuration. Technical operations configu

attributes.name: demographic_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to audience.demographic_segment. Business justification: Dayparts are defined by target demographic (target_demographic is a denormalized plain column). Linking daypart to demographic_segment enables proper GRP calculation, rate card pricing, and upfront pl

attributes.name: genre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.genre. Business justification: Dayparts have genre affinity rules (kids daypart restricts to children's genre, news daypart to news/current affairs). Linking to content.genre enables automated scheduling constraint enforcement and

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation.
