attributes.name: ad_pod_count
attributes.description: The number of ad pods (groups of advertisements within a break) scheduled within this program. Used for advertising inventory planning, Wide Orbit traffic scheduling, and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); SCTE-35

attributes.name: blackout_region_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic region or market codes where this program is subject to broadcast blackout restrictions. Used by distribution systems to suppress EPG entry delivery in restricted markets. Populated only when is_blackout is True.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; FCC Blackout Rules 47 CFR Part 76

attributes.name: broadcast_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this program is scheduled to air, in yyyy-MM-dd format. Used for day-level EPG grid display, daypart assignment, and schedule reporting.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: distribution_window
attributes.description: The distribution window or release strategy under which this EPG entry is being broadcast, reflecting the windowing strategy for sequential content release. Determines rights availability and platform eligibility per Rightsline contract terms.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Motion Picture Association (MPA) Windowing Guidelines

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: The total scheduled duration of the program in seconds, derived from the difference between scheduled start and end times. Used for EPG display, ad pod planning, and playout automation validation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SCTE-35

attributes.name: eidr
attributes.description: The Entertainment Identifier Registry (EIDR) identifier for this content, providing a universal content identifier used across the media supply chain for content tracking, rights management, and EPG data exchange with MVPDs and vMVPDs.
attributes.references: Entertainment Identifier Registry (EIDR) Association; Motion Picture Association (MPA)

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this EPG entry within the scheduling workflow. 'draft' indicates pending review; 'approved' indicates cleared for distribution; 'published' indicates actively distributed to EPG feeds; 'cancelled' indicates removed from schedule; 'expired' indicates the broadcast window has passed.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: epg_entry_code
attributes.description: Externally distributed business identifier for this EPG entry, used in feeds delivered to MVPDs, vMVPDs, set-top boxes, and digital platforms for program discovery. Format: EPG-{CHANNEL}-{YYYYMMDD}-{HHMMSS}.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: epg_feed_version
attributes.description: The version number of this EPG entry record as distributed in the EPG feed. Incremented each time the entry is updated and redistributed to MVPDs, vMVPDs, and digital platforms. Enables downstream systems to detect and apply updates.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: episode_number
attributes.description: The sequential episode number within the season for this EPG entry. Used for viewer navigation and content ordering in EPG feeds. Null for non-episodic content.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol

attributes.name: episode_title
attributes.description: The title of the specific episode within a series, as displayed in the EPG. Null for non-episodic content such as feature films or standalone specials.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: genre_primary
attributes.description: The primary content genre classification for this EPG entry as distributed in the EPG feed (e.g., Drama, Comedy, News, Sports, Documentary, Reality). Used for viewer discovery, content filtering, and audience analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: drama|comedy|news|sports|documentary|reality|entertainment|children|film|music — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DVB SI EN 300 468 Content Descriptor; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: genre_secondary
attributes.description: An optional secondary genre sub-classification providing more granular content categorization for EPG discovery and audience targeting (e.g., Crime Drama, Political Comedy, Investigative Documentary).

attributes.name: is_blackout
attributes.description: Indicates whether geographic broadcast restrictions (blackout) apply to this EPG entry (True). When True, the program is subject to blackout rules that restrict distribution in specific geographic markets per rights agreements managed in Rightsline.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; FCC Must-Carry and Blackout Rules 47 CFR Part 76

attributes.name: is_closed_caption
attributes.description: Indicates whether closed captioning (CC) is available for this program (True). Distributed in EPG feeds for accessibility compliance and viewer information. Required for FCC closed captioning regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 79 Closed Captioning; Twenty-First Century Communications and Video Accessibility Act (CVAA)

attributes.name: is_hdr
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program is available in High Dynamic Range (HDR) format (True). Distributed in EPG feeds to inform viewers and set-top boxes of enhanced picture quality availability.
attributes.references: ATSC A/341 High Dynamic Range; DVB HDR Specification

attributes.name: is_live
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EPG entry represents a live broadcast event (True) as opposed to a pre-recorded or time-shifted program (False). Drives playout automation configuration in Ericsson MediaFirst and is distributed in EPG feeds for viewer-facing live indicators.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: is_new_episode
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EPG entry represents a new, first-run episode (True) or a repeat/rerun broadcast (False). Distributed in EPG feeds for viewer-facing 'NEW' indicators and drives audience measurement prioritization.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: is_simulcast
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program is being simultaneously broadcast across multiple platforms or channels (simulcast). When True, the same content is distributed concurrently on linear and digital/OTT platforms.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: isan
attributes.description: The International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN) uniquely identifying this audiovisual work globally. Used for rights management, content identification across platforms, and interoperability with Rightsline and international content registries.
attributes.references: ISO 15706-2 International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN); ISAN International Agency

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: The primary audio language of the program, expressed as a three-letter ISO 639-2 language code (e.g., 'eng' for English, 'spa' for Spanish). Used in EPG feeds for language filtering and accessibility compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 639-2 Language Codes; ATSC A/65; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this EPG entry record was most recently modified, including schedule changes, metadata updates, or status transitions. Used for change detection in downstream EPG feed distribution and audit trail.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this EPG entry was first published and distributed to external EPG feeds (MVPDs, vMVPDs, set-top boxes, digital platforms). Serves as the record audit created timestamp for this data product.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: rights_window_end
attributes.description: The end date of the broadcast rights window during which this content is cleared for transmission on this channel. After this date, the content enters a holdback period and cannot be broadcast without rights renewal in Rightsline.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Motion Picture Association (MPA) Windowing Guidelines

attributes.name: rights_window_start
attributes.description: The start date of the broadcast rights window during which this content is cleared for transmission on this channel. Derived from Rightsline contract availabilities and used to validate schedule compliance.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Motion Picture Association (MPA) Windowing Guidelines

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which this program is scheduled to end broadcast on the channel. Used to calculate program duration and to sequence adjacent EPG entries in the linear channel grid.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which this program is scheduled to begin broadcast on the channel, expressed in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. This is the principal business event timestamp for the EPG entry and drives all downstream playout automation in Ericsson MediaFirst.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: scte35_cue_out_time
attributes.description: The timestamp of the SCTE-35 splice_insert cue-out signal marking the start of an ad break opportunity within this program. Used by Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) systems and Wide Orbit traffic systems for ad pod placement and automated ad scheduling.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message Standard; Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers (SCTE)

attributes.name: season_number
attributes.description: The season number within the series for this episode. Used for EPG display and content navigation. Null for non-episodic or non-seasonal content.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol

attributes.name: synopsis_long
attributes.description: A detailed program description (typically up to 500 characters) distributed in EPG feeds for display on digital platforms, OTT apps, and web-based program guides. Sourced from Dalet Galaxy content metadata.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: synopsis_short
attributes.description: A brief program description (typically up to 100 characters) distributed in EPG feeds for display on set-top boxes and digital platforms with limited screen real estate. Sourced from Dalet Galaxy content metadata.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: total_ad_break_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The total cumulative duration in seconds of all scheduled ad breaks within this program. Used for advertising inventory management, compliance with ad load regulations, and Wide Orbit traffic scheduling.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; FCC Commercial Limits in Children's Programming; IAB

attributes.name: video_resolution
attributes.description: The video resolution format of this program as distributed in the EPG feed (e.g., SD, HD, FHD, UHD/4K). Used for viewer-facing display in EPG interfaces and for platform compatibility routing.
attributes.references: ATSC A/53 Digital Television Standard; DVB Digital Video Broadcasting Standards

products.name: ad_break
products.description: Commercial break (ad pod) within a schedule slot — capturing break position (pre-roll, mid-roll, post-roll), sequence number, planned and maximum pod duration, break type (local avail, network avail, promotional), SCTE-35 cue-in/cue-out marker references, DAI eligibility flag, and Wide Orbit traffic system break ID. The structural container for sellable ad inventory within the linear schedule, linking scheduling to advertising sales fulfillment.
products.reference: SCTE-35 Ad Pod / Wide Orbit Break

attributes.name: ad_break_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the ad break (ad pod) record within the scheduling domain. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the broadcast channel on which this ad break is scheduled for playout. Supports multi-channel scheduling and channel-level inventory reporting.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: dai_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.dai_configuration. Business justification: Linear ad breaks drive DAI stitching rules when simulcast to OTT. Operations teams configure DAI parameters (max pod duration, fill rate targets, frequency caps) per break type and daypart to ensure c

attributes.name: daypart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.daypart. Business justification: Ad break currently stores daypart_code as a STRING. This should be normalized to FK to the daypart reference table. Ad break pricing, GRP targets, and inventory management all depend on daypart attrib

attributes.name: delivery_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.delivery_channel. Business justification: Ad breaks are sold and delivered per delivery channel. Ad operations and traffic systems need the delivery channel association to apply channel-specific ad pod rules, DAI configuration, and revenue at

attributes.name: market_coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to audience.market_coverage. Business justification: Ad breaks carry blackout_restricted and content_restriction_code flags that are market-specific. Linking ad_break to market_coverage enables market-level ad restriction enforcement, blackout complianc

attributes.name: political_ad_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.political_ad_record. Business justification: Political ad breaks require detailed public inspection file documentation per FCC Section 315 (reasonable access, lowest unit charge). Each political ad break must link to compliance record for public

attributes.name: program_rundown_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.program_rundown. Business justification: Ad breaks within a live or studio program are planned as part of the program rundown (rundown_item records with ad_pod_flag=true). Linking ad_break.program_rundown_id → program_rundown enables reconci

attributes.name: revenue_stream_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.revenue_stream. Business justification: Ad breaks are the primary advertising revenue mechanism. Revenue recognition, sales reconciliation, and makegood accounting all depend on ad-break-to-revenue-stream mapping. Essential for advertising

attributes.name: schedule_slot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent schedule slot within which this ad break is positioned. Links the ad break to its containing program or interstitial window in the linear channel grid.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: actual_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The actual total duration of the ad break as recorded during playout by the Ericsson MediaFirst automation system. Used for post-log reconciliation, affidavit generation, and makegood assessment when actual duration deviates from planned.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System (Affidavits)

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: The actual wall-clock time at which the ad break commenced during playout, as recorded by the Ericsson MediaFirst automation system. Used for affidavit generation and post-log reconciliation against the scheduled start time.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System (Affidavits)

attributes.name: affidavit_generated
attributes.description: Indicates whether a proof-of-broadcast affidavit has been generated for this ad break in the Wide Orbit traffic system following confirmed playout. Affidavits are required for advertiser billing reconciliation and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System (Affidavits); FCC Sponsorship Identification Rules

attributes.name: automation_event_code
attributes.description: The event identifier assigned by the Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation system to the break trigger event. Used to correlate the scheduled ad break with the actual playout automation log for post-log reconciliation and technical fault analysis.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: avail_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual advertising avail slots (unit positions) within this ad break pod. Each avail represents a discrete sellable unit (e.g., a 30-second spot position). Used for inventory capacity planning and traffic scheduling.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Advertising Standards

attributes.name: blackout_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ad break is subject to geographic blackout restrictions that prevent its broadcast or streaming in specific markets or regions. When true, downstream distribution systems must apply blackout logic per rights and regulatory obligations.
attributes.references: FCC Blackout Rules (47 CFR Part 76); Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management

attributes.name: break_position
attributes.description: Positional classification of the ad break relative to the surrounding program content. 'pre-roll' = before program content begins; 'mid-roll' = within program content; 'post-roll' = after program content ends; 'interstitial' = between programs in the schedule grid.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Standard

attributes.name: break_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ad break within the scheduling and playout workflow. 'scheduled' = planned but not yet confirmed; 'confirmed' = traffic-confirmed with sold inventory; 'aired' = playout completed and affidavit-eligible; 'cancelled' = removed from schedule; 'hold' = temporarily suspended pending resolution.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: break_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ad break by inventory ownership and commercial purpose. 'local_avail' = inventory sold by local affiliate; 'network_avail' = inventory sold by the network; 'promotional' = house promotional content; 'public_service' = public service announcements; 'emergency' = emergency alert system override. Drives revenue attribution and traffic scheduling rules.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; FCC Public Service Announcement Requirements

attributes.name: broadcast_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this ad break is scheduled to air, expressed in the channel's broadcast day convention (which may differ from the wall-clock date for late-night programming). Used for daily traffic scheduling, affidavit generation, and revenue reporting.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; FCC Affidavit Requirements

attributes.name: content_restriction_code
attributes.description: A code indicating any content category restrictions applicable to advertising within this break (e.g., no alcohol ads during children's programming, no competitor ads). Enforced by the traffic system during ad assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NO_ALCOHOL|NO_GAMBLING|NO_PHARMA|NO_COMPETITOR|CHILDREN_SAFE|NONE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FCC Children's Television Act (COPPA); Ofcom Broadcasting Code; MPA Content Rating Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ad break record was first created in the scheduling system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Data Integrity Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the rate card CPM and any monetary values associated with this ad break (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency operations for international broadcast networks.

attributes.name: dai_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ad break is enabled for Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI), allowing server-side ad replacement for OTT/streaming simulcast audiences. When true, the break is eligible for addressable advertising via DAI platforms such as those integrated with Akamai CDN.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Standard; Akamai CDN

attributes.name: epg_break_label
attributes.description: The human-readable label or descriptor for this ad break as it appears in the Electronic Program Guide (EPG) and scheduling rundown. Used by traffic coordinators and scheduling operators to identify breaks in the EPG interface.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol

attributes.name: grp_target
attributes.description: The target Gross Rating Point (GRP) value for this ad break, representing the expected total audience delivery as a percentage of the total target population. Used for audience guarantee tracking and campaign delivery reporting against Nielsen ratings.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: makegood_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a makegood (compensatory ad spot) is required for this break due to a failure to air as contracted — for example, due to preemption, technical failure, or underdelivery. Triggers makegood workflow in Wide Orbit.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Advertising Standards (Makegoods)

attributes.name: max_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The maximum allowable duration of the ad break in seconds, representing the hard ceiling for total ad content that may be inserted. Exceeding this value would cause schedule overrun. May differ from planned duration when flex time is permitted.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: nielsen_program_rating
attributes.description: The Nielsen audience rating for the program surrounding this ad break, representing the percentage of total TV households tuned in. Used for CPM calculation, audience guarantee assessment, and scatter market pricing.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; Nielsen Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: planned_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The planned total duration of the ad break (ad pod) in seconds as defined in the program schedule. Represents the total sellable commercial time allocated to this break. Standard pod durations are typically 30, 60, 90, 120, or 180 seconds.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: pod_number
attributes.description: The pod number identifying this ad break within the broadcast day for the channel. Distinct from sequence_number (which is relative to the program); pod_number is the channel-day-level ordinal used in traffic scheduling and affidavit reporting.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST)

attributes.name: preemption_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why this ad break was preempted or cancelled if it did not air as scheduled. Used for makegood processing, revenue assurance, and operational reporting. 'none' when the break aired as planned.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; FCC Emergency Alert System Rules

attributes.name: rate_card_cpm
attributes.description: The published rate card CPM (Cost Per Mille — cost per 1,000 audience impressions) for this ad break, expressed in the local currency. Represents the base pricing for inventory in this break before negotiated discounts. Used for revenue forecasting and yield management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Media Cloud Ad Sales; IAB CPM Pricing Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The planned wall-clock date and time at which the ad break is scheduled to begin on the linear channel. Expressed in the channel's broadcast timezone. This is the principal BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for the break.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Standard

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this ad break within the parent schedule slot or program. Used to order multiple breaks within a single program (e.g., break 1, break 2, break 3) for traffic scheduling and playout automation.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: simulcast_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ad break is included in the simultaneous multi-platform broadcast (simulcast) of the channel. When false, the break may be suppressed or replaced on simulcast streams (e.g., OTT, vMVPD).
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST)

attributes.name: sold_avail_count
attributes.description: The number of individual avail slots within this break that have been sold and assigned to advertiser spots in the Wide Orbit traffic system. Used with avail_count to compute sellout rate and unsold inventory.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Salesforce Media Cloud Ad Sales

attributes.name: sold_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The total duration in seconds of ad inventory within this break that has been sold to advertisers via the Wide Orbit traffic system. Used to calculate unsold (remnant) inventory and sellout rate for revenue assurance reporting.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Salesforce Media Cloud Ad Sales

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ad break record was most recently modified in the scheduling system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Data Integrity Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: wide_orbit_break_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Wide Orbit Traffic System Break ID
attributes.description: The externally-known break identifier assigned by the Wide Orbit traffic and billing system. Used to reconcile ad break inventory between the scheduling domain and the ad sales/traffic fulfillment workflow. This is the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for the break as known to the traffic system.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System

products.name: simulcast_config
products.description: Configuration record defining a simulcast relationship where a single program or schedule is broadcast simultaneously across multiple channels or platforms (e.g., linear + OTT, HD + SD, primary + secondary feed). Captures source channel, target channel or platform, simulcast type (full-feed, partial, time-shifted), offset in seconds, audio/video profile mapping, and active date range. Drives Ericsson MediaFirst multi-feed automation.

attributes.name: simulcast_config_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the simulcast configuration record. Primary key for this entity in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: abr_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) streaming profile applied to the target simulcast feed for OTT delivery. Defines the bitrate ladder (HLS or MPEG-DASH renditions) used by Akamai CDN for adaptive streaming to end-user devices.
attributes.references: ISO 23009 MPEG-DASH; HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) Apple Specification; Akamai CDN

attributes.name: accessibility_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.accessibility_obligation. Business justification: Simulcast configurations carry audio_description_passthrough and closed_caption_passthrough settings that must comply with specific accessibility obligations (CVAA, FCC closed captioning rules for IP-

attributes.name: affiliate_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.affiliate_agreement. Business justification: Affiliate agreements contain simulcast_requirement_flag and digital_rights_included_flag that govern simulcast configurations for affiliate stations. Linking simulcast_config to the affiliate agreemen

attributes.name: dai_configuration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.dai_configuration. Business justification: Simulcast routes require DAI stitching rules when ad insertion differs between linear SCTE-35 cues and OTT server-side stitching. Technical operations configure DAI per simulcast to handle ad pod subs

attributes.name: delivery_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.delivery_channel. Business justification: Simulcast configurations define simultaneous distribution across delivery channels. The target delivery channel for a simulcast config is needed for DAI substitution rules, blackout enforcement, and r

attributes.name: distribution_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.distribution_agreement. Business justification: Simulcast configurations are authorized and governed by distribution agreements that specify streaming rights, simulcast requirements, and DRM obligations. Linking simulcast_config to the governing di

attributes.name: drm_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.drm_policy. Business justification: Simulcast configurations specify DRM requirements; drm_scheme is a denormalized plain attribute. Replacing with FK to drm_policy normalizes DRM enforcement, enables automated policy application during

attributes.name: format_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mediaasset.format_specification. Business justification: Simulcast configurations define the output format for each distribution platform (HLS 1080p for OTT, SD H.264 for cable). Linking to format_specification enables automated transcode job creation and f

attributes.name: license_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rights.license_agreement. Business justification: Simulcast configurations must be authorized by a license agreement granting simulcast rights for the specific territory and platform. Distribution teams verify license agreement simulcast permissions

attributes.name: primary_simulcast_backup_source_channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the backup or secondary source channel used by Ericsson MediaFirst failover automation when the primary source channel becomes unavailable. Supports broadcast continuity and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SLA (Service Level Agreement) Standards

attributes.name: rights_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rights.rights_territory. Business justification: simulcast_config.rights_territory_code is a denormalized reference to rights_territory. Simulcast configurations are territory-specific; the rights_territory record defines regulatory parameters, blac

attributes.name: simulcast_partner_partner_partner_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Simulcast Partner Partner Partner Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner_partner. Business justification: Simulcast distribution agreements are with specific partners (cable operators, streaming platforms, syndication partners). Critical for multi-platform distribution tracking, partner SLA compliance, an

attributes.name: source_channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating linear broadcast channel whose feed is being simulcast to one or more target channels or platforms. Drives Ericsson MediaFirst multi-feed automation as the master playout source.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: streaming_endpoint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.streaming_endpoint. Business justification: Simulcast configurations map linear channels to specific OTT delivery endpoints for live streaming workflows. Operations teams configure CDN routing, failover paths, and geo-restrictions per simulcast

attributes.name: subscription_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to subscriber.subscription_plan. Business justification: Simulcast configurations (e.g., 4K HDR streams, multi-audio) are gated to specific subscription plan tiers in OTT operations. This FK enables the distribution system to enforce plan-level simulcast el

attributes.name: target_channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the destination channel or platform that receives the simulcast feed from the source channel. May represent a linear channel, OTT platform feed, HD/SD variant, or secondary distribution outlet.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: ad_pod_substitution
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ad pods (groups of ads in a break) from the source linear feed are substituted with alternative ad content on the target simulcast feed. Distinct from DAI — covers cases where static alternate ad content replaces source pods without dynamic targeting.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; SCTE-35; IAB

attributes.name: audio_description_passthrough
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audio description (video description) secondary audio track is passed through from the source to the target simulcast feed. Required for FCC accessibility compliance for visually impaired audiences on qualifying broadcast and MVPD platforms.
attributes.references: FCC Audio Description Rules (47 CFR Part 79.3); Twenty-First Century Communications and Video Accessibility Act (CVAA)

attributes.name: blackout_enforced
attributes.description: Indicates whether geographic broadcast blackout restrictions are enforced on the target simulcast feed. When true, blackout rules (e.g., sports rights geographic restrictions) are applied to suppress content in restricted territories on the target platform.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Blackout Rules (47 CFR Part 76); Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management

attributes.name: cdn_origin_path
attributes.description: The Akamai CDN origin ingest path or stream key for the target simulcast feed. Used to route the encoded simulcast stream from Ericsson MediaFirst playout to the CDN origin for OTT and digital distribution.
attributes.references: Akamai CDN Content Delivery Network; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: closed_caption_passthrough
attributes.description: Indicates whether closed caption data from the source channel feed is passed through to the target simulcast feed. Required for FCC accessibility compliance on all broadcast and MVPD distribution platforms.
attributes.references: FCC Closed Captioning Rules (47 CFR Part 79); Twenty-First Century Communications and Video Accessibility Act (CVAA)

attributes.name: config_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this simulcast configuration, used in Ericsson MediaFirst automation rules, runsheets, and operational documentation. Unique across all active configurations.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: config_description
attributes.description: Free-text operational description of the simulcast configuration, including business rationale, special handling instructions, and notes for scheduling and playout operations teams.

attributes.name: config_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the simulcast configuration (e.g., 'CNN HD to CNN SD Full-Feed', 'Linear to OTT Time-Shifted +1hr'). Used in EPG management and scheduling operations.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: content_rating_restriction
attributes.description: Maximum content rating permitted on the target simulcast feed per Motion Picture Association (MPA) and FCC content rating standards. Ensures age-appropriate content controls are applied on the target platform, particularly for COPPA-regulated children's platforms.
attributes.references: FCC Content Rating Rules; Motion Picture Association (MPA) Content Ratings; COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this simulcast configuration record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for configuration lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Trail Requirements; Media Broadcasting Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: dai_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) is active on the target simulcast feed, replacing linear ad pods with dynamically served targeted advertisements. Applicable primarily to OTT and AVOD distribution platforms.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); SCTE-35; Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers (SCTE)

attributes.name: distribution_platform
attributes.description: The delivery platform type of the target channel or feed. Distinguishes linear broadcast from OTT (Over-The-Top), MVPD (Multichannel Video Programming Distributor), vMVPD (Virtual MVPD), FAST (Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television), cable, satellite, IPTV, or web delivery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: linear|ott|mvpd|vmvpd|fast|cable|satellite|iptv|web — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); DVB Project Digital Video Broadcasting Standards

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this simulcast configuration becomes operationally active and is applied by Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation. Aligns with schedule activation windows in the EPG.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/76

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this simulcast configuration expires and is deactivated. Nullable for open-ended configurations with no planned end date. Supports windowing and holdback period management.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management

attributes.name: epg_sync_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Electronic Program Guide (EPG) metadata from the source channel schedule is automatically synchronized to the target simulcast channel's EPG. When true, program titles, descriptions, and ratings are mirrored to the target channel grid.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol (PSIP)

attributes.name: failover_mode
attributes.description: Defines the failover behavior for the simulcast target feed in Ericsson MediaFirst when the source channel signal is lost or degraded. Automatic triggers immediate failover to backup source; manual requires operator intervention; disabled means no failover is configured.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SLA (Service Level Agreement) Standards

attributes.name: graphics_passthrough
attributes.description: Indicates whether on-screen graphics, lower-thirds, and channel branding overlays from the source channel are passed through to the target simulcast feed. When false, the target feed may apply its own branding or suppress source graphics.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: mediafirst_config_ref
attributes.description: The external configuration reference identifier assigned by Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation system to this simulcast configuration. Used for reconciliation between the data lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational playout system.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: must_carry_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this simulcast configuration satisfies must-carry obligations requiring MVPDs to carry local broadcast stations. Ensures regulatory compliance tracking for FCC must-carry and retransmission consent requirements.
attributes.references: FCC Must-Carry Rules (47 CFR Part 76 Subpart D); Federal Communications Commission (FCC)

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for this simulcast configuration when multiple configurations apply to the same source channel simultaneously. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used by Ericsson MediaFirst to resolve conflicts in multi-feed automation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: scte35_cue_passthrough
attributes.description: Indicates whether SCTE-35 digital program insertion cue markers from the source channel are passed through to the target simulcast feed. When true, ad break triggers and blackout signals are propagated to the target. Critical for DAI (Dynamic Ad Insertion) on OTT platforms.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message for Cable Systems; IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST)

attributes.name: simulcast_config_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the simulcast configuration record. Active configurations are processed by Ericsson MediaFirst automation. Suspended configurations are temporarily halted (e.g., rights blackout). Draft configurations are under review prior to activation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Media Broadcasting Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: simulcast_type
attributes.description: Classification of the simulcast relationship: full_feed (identical content and timing), partial (selected programs only), time_shifted (offset delay applied), simulcast_only (live events only), ad_substituted (DAI replaces linear ad pods on target). Drives automation logic in Ericsson MediaFirst.
attributes.references: ATSC A/76 Practice Recommended for Simulcasting; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: time_offset_seconds
attributes.description: The delay in seconds applied to the target feed relative to the source channel. Zero for true simultaneous simulcast. Positive values indicate a time-shifted delay (e.g., +3600 for a +1 hour catch-up feed). Used by Ericsson MediaFirst to schedule playout offset.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this simulcast configuration record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking and audit compliance for playout configuration governance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Trail Requirements; Media Broadcasting Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: watermark_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether a forensic or visible watermark is applied to the target simulcast feed for content protection, piracy detection, and rights enforcement tracking. Supports MPA anti-piracy compliance.
attributes.references: Motion Picture Association (MPA) Anti-Piracy Standards; Akamai CDN Security

The authoritative as-run record serving as the evidentiary basis for affidavit generation, rights usage reporting, advertiser billing reconciliation, and regulatory proof-of-performance.

attributes.name: affidavit_generated

attributes.name: automation_mode

attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: blackout_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this playout event was subject to a geographic broadcast blackout restriction. When true, the event was blacked out in one or more markets per rights or regulatory obligations.
attributes.references: FCC Blackout Rules; Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management

attributes.name: broadcast_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this playout event was transmitted, expressed in the channel's local broadcast day (which may differ from UTC date for overnight programming).
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC Standards

attributes.name: broadcast_standard
attributes.description: Technical broadcast standard under which this playout event was transmitted. Determines encoding, modulation, and compliance requirements.
attributes.references: ATSC (Advanced Television Systems Committee) Standards; DVB Project (Digital Video Broadcasting) Standards; ISO/IEC 14496 MPEG-4

attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: Content rating classification of the transmitted asset as defined by the Motion Picture Association (MPA) TV Parental Guidelines. Used for COPPA compliance, watershed enforcement, and FCC children's programming obligations.
attributes.references: Motion Picture Association (MPA) TV Parental Guidelines; FCC Children's Television Act; COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this as-run playout event record was first ingested into the Silver layer from the Ericsson MediaFirst as-run log. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Requirements

attributes.name: dai_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this playout event was eligible for Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) on OTT/streaming platforms. Used for digital advertising reconciliation and DAI revenue attribution.
attributes.references: IAB DAI (Dynamic Ad Insertion) Standards; SCTE-35 Standard

attributes.name: dalet_asset_code
attributes.description: Asset identifier in the Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management system for the content transmitted in this playout event. Used for digital asset reconciliation and archive linkage.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the playout event by content category. Determines applicable rights, billing rules, and regulatory requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: program|commercial|promo|interstitial|filler|ident|emergency_alert — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SCTE Standards; IAB Digital Advertising Standards

attributes.name: failover_activated

attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: isan_code

attributes.name: isci_code

attributes.name: mediafirst_event_code

attributes.name: must_carry_flag

attributes.name: playout_status
attributes.description: Outcome status of the playout event as recorded in the Ericsson MediaFirst as-run log. 'aired' = transmitted as planned; 'skipped' = omitted from transmission; 'substituted' = replaced with alternate content; 'failed' = transmission error; 'partial' = incomplete transmission; 'delayed' = transmitted late.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; FCC Proof-of-Performance Requirements

attributes.name: rights_clearance_status
attributes.description: Rights clearance status of the content asset at the time of transmission. 'cleared' = rights verified and valid; 'pending' = clearance in progress; 'expired' = rights window had lapsed; 'restricted' = transmission was restricted. Used for rights compliance audit and Rightsline reconciliation.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; FCC Compliance

attributes.name: scheduled_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Planned duration of the playout event in seconds as defined in the program schedule rundown. Used as the baseline for duration deviation analysis.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Planned transmission start time for this event as defined in the Electronic Program Guide (EPG) and program schedule rundown. Used as the baseline for schedule deviation calculation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; EPG (Electronic Program Guide) Standards

attributes.name: simulcast_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this playout event was simultaneously broadcast across multiple platforms (simulcast). When true, the event was transmitted on additional channels or OTT platforms concurrently.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC Standards

attributes.name: start_deviation_seconds
attributes.description: Difference in seconds between actual_start_time and scheduled_start_time. Positive values indicate late start; negative values indicate early start. Key metric for schedule adherence and SLA reporting.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SLA (Service Level Agreement) Standards

attributes.name: substitution_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the originally scheduled content was substituted with alternate content. Populated only when playout_status is 'substituted'. Used for rights compliance and editorial audit trails.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; FCC Compliance

attributes.name: transmission_type
attributes.description: Mode of content delivery for this playout event. 'linear' = traditional scheduled broadcast; 'vod' = Video On Demand; 'simulcast' = simultaneous multi-platform; 'ott' = Over-The-Top streaming; 'fast' = Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC Standards; DVB Project Standards

attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Spend Report; ATSC Standards; DVB Project

attributes.name: rights_clearance_status
attributes.description: The current rights clearance verification status for this availability window. 'cleared' means all rights have been confirmed for the platform, territory, and window period; 'pending' means clearance is in progress; 'blocked' means a rights conflict prevents availability; 'expired' means rights have lapsed; 'not_required' means no clearance is needed.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management — Rights Clearance; FCC Retransmission Consent Rules

attributes.name: rightsline_window_ref
attributes.description: The native window reference identifier from the Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management system. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the scheduling domain and the rights domain to ensure operational parameters align with contractual rights.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management — Availability Windows Module

attributes.name: scte35_cue_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether SCTE-35 digital program insertion cue markers are enabled for this availability window. When True, SCTE-35 splice points are embedded in the stream to signal ad break opportunities for DAI systems.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message Standard; Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers (SCTE)

attributes.name: simulcast_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this availability window is part of a simulcast configuration, meaning the content is being delivered simultaneously across multiple platforms or channels at the same time.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management — Simulcast Configuration; ATSC Standards

attributes.name: stagger_offset_days
attributes.description: For staggered windowing strategy, the number of days this platform's availability window is offset relative to the primary release platform or theatrical/linear premiere date. Zero indicates simultaneous release; positive values indicate delayed release.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management — Windowing Strategy; MPA Content Distribution Guidelines

attributes.name: streaming_protocol
attributes.description: The adaptive bitrate (ABR) streaming protocol used to deliver the content during this availability window. HLS = HTTP Live Streaming; MPEG-DASH = Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP; SMOOTH = Microsoft Smooth Streaming; PROGRESSIVE = progressive download.
attributes.references: ATSC Standards; DVB Project; ISO/IEC 23009 MPEG-DASH; HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) RFC 8216

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code identifying the geographic territory in which this availability window applies. Used to enforce blackout obligations, retransmission consent, and territorial rights restrictions.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; FCC Blackout Rules; Ofcom Broadcasting Standards

attributes.name: territory_scope
attributes.description: Broad geographic scope classification for the availability window. 'worldwide' means no territorial restriction; 'regional' means a multi-country region; 'national' means a single country; 'local' means a sub-national market; 'excluded' means the territory is explicitly excluded from availability.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management — Territory Scope; MPA Anti-Piracy and Distribution Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this availability window record was last modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability; SOX Internal Controls; ISO 8601

attributes.name: window_close_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone offset) at which the content title expires and is no longer available on the specified platform. Null indicates an open-ended window with no defined expiry.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management — Availability End; ISO 8601 Datetime Standard

attributes.name: window_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier code for this availability window, used in operational systems such as Rightsline and Dalet Galaxy for cross-system reference and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management — Window Reference Code

attributes.name: window_duration_days
attributes.description: The total duration of the availability window in days, calculated as the difference between window_close_timestamp and window_open_timestamp. Stored as an operational field for scheduling and reporting purposes. Null for open-ended windows.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management — Window Duration; Internal Scheduling Operations

attributes.name: window_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or comments associated with this availability window, capturing scheduling rationale, rights exceptions, platform-specific instructions, or escalation context for scheduling operations teams.
attributes.references: Internal Scheduling Operations — Dalet Galaxy Workflow Notes

attributes.name: window_open_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone offset) at which the content title becomes available on the specified platform. This is the principal business event timestamp for the availability window lifecycle.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management — Availability Start; ISO 8601 Datetime Standard

attributes.name: window_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the availability window. 'draft' indicates configuration in progress; 'scheduled' means approved but not yet open; 'active' means currently available to audiences; 'expired' means the window close datetime has passed; 'cancelled' means removed before activation; 'suspended' means temporarily withheld.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management — Schedule Status; Rightsline Availability Status

attributes.name: windowing_strategy
attributes.description: The sequential release strategy applied to this availability window. 'day_and_date' means simultaneous release across all platforms; 'staggered' means delayed release relative to another platform; 'exclusive' means available only on this platform for the window duration; 'holdback' means content is withheld from this platform during the window; 'rolling' means a continuously refreshed window; 'simultaneous' means released at the same time as theatrical or linear broadcast.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management — Windowing Strategy; MPA Content Distribution Guidelines

domains.name: distribution
domains.description: Governs multi-platform content delivery across linear broadcast (DVB, ATSC, QAM), OTT streaming (HLS, MPEG-DASH, ABR), MVPD/vMVPD carriage, FAST channel syndication, and OTT platform infrastructure. Manages CDN configuration, DRM enforcement, DAI, streaming endpoints, ABR profiles, device support, QoS monitoring, and all delivery SLAs.

products.name: ott_platform
products.description: Master registry of all OTT service platforms operated by Media Broadcasting — web, mobile, connected TV (CTV), and set-top box (STB). Captures platform identity, service tier (SVOD, AVOD, TVOD, FAST), launch date, supported protocols (HLS, MPEG-DASH), DRM system bindings, CDN provider assignments, geographic availability, regulatory jurisdiction, brand identity, and operational status. This is the SSOT anchor for the entire platform domain — all other platform products reference back to this entity.

attributes.name: ott_platform_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each OTT service platform record in the master registry. Primary key for the ott_platform entity — all downstream distribution products reference this key.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.revenue_stream. Business justification: Each OTT platform tier (SVOD, AVOD, TVOD) maps to a distinct revenue stream for ASC 606 performance obligation identification and segment revenue reporting. Media finance requires platform-level reven
