attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rights.territory. Business justification: OTT platforms operate in specific territories with distinct regulatory, content rating, and rights enforcement requirements. Replaces geographic_availability text with structured territory reference.

attributes.name: adobe_property_code
attributes.description: The unique property identifier assigned to this OTT platform within Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) for audience data collection, segmentation, and personalization. Used to link platform-level engagement events to subscriber profiles and Nielsen cross-platform measurement.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: arpu
attributes.description: Average monthly revenue generated per active subscriber on this platform, expressed in the platform's billing currency. Calculated at the platform level for strategic pricing and investor reporting. Confidential as a key financial performance indicator. Sourced from Zuora revenue recognition data.
attributes.references: Zuora Subscription Billing and Revenue; SOX Financial Reporting; EBITDA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: base_subscription_price
attributes.description: The standard monthly subscription price for this platform in the billing currency. Applicable for SVOD and HYBRID tiers. Null for AVOD and FAST platforms with no subscription fee. Used in Zuora plan configuration and financial forecasting in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Zuora Subscription Billing and Revenue; SAP S/4HANA CO; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: billing_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the primary billing currency used on this platform (e.g., 'USD', 'GBP', 'EUR'). Governs Zuora subscription plan pricing, SAP S/4HANA financial reconciliation, and multi-currency revenue reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SOX Financial Reporting; Zuora Subscription Billing and Revenue; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: content_rating_system
attributes.description: The content classification and rating system applied to content on this platform (e.g., MPAA for USA, BBFC for UK, FSK for Germany). Governs parental control enforcement, COPPA compliance for children's content, and MPA anti-piracy obligations.
attributes.references: Motion Picture Association (MPA) Content Ratings; COPPA; Ofcom Broadcasting Standards; FCC Broadcast Licensing

attributes.name: coppa_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this platform is designated as COPPA-compliant, meaning it is directed at children under 13 and adheres to COPPA data collection restrictions. True = COPPA-compliant children's platform; False = general audience platform. Drives data collection policies in Adobe Experience Platform and ad targeting restrictions.
attributes.references: COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); FCC Broadcast Licensing; IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this OTT platform record was first created in the master registry. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, audit trails, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 8601

attributes.name: dai_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Dynamic Ad Insertion is active on this platform, enabling server-side ad stitching into the stream. True = DAI active (relevant for AVOD and HYBRID tiers); False = no DAI. Drives ad operations workflow in Wide Orbit and ad campaign targeting in Salesforce Media Cloud.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); SCTE 35 Ad Insertion Standards; Wide Orbit Traffic System

attributes.name: dai_provider
attributes.description: The technology vendor or platform providing DAI services for this OTT platform (e.g., 'Google DAI', 'FreeWheel', 'Yospace', 'Brightcove SSAI'). Null if DAI is not enabled. Used for vendor management, SLA tracking, and ad revenue reconciliation.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); SCTE 35 Ad Insertion Standards

attributes.name: epg_feed_url
attributes.description: The URL of the Electronic Program Guide data feed for this platform, used by third-party EPG aggregators, smart TV manufacturers, and vMVPD partners to display scheduling information. Null for pure VOD platforms without a linear schedule. Sourced from Ericsson MediaFirst playout system.
attributes.references: ATSC 3.0; DVB Project Standards; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout System; IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: fast_channel_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television (FAST) Channel Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this platform operates or hosts FAST channels — linear-style, ad-supported free streaming channels. True = FAST channel delivery active; False = no FAST channel. Relevant for FAST syndication partnerships and Wide Orbit ad scheduling.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards; SCTE 35 Ad Insertion Standards; Wide Orbit Traffic System

attributes.name: free_trial_days
attributes.description: Number of days in the free trial period offered to new subscribers on this platform. Zero or null if no free trial is offered. Configured in Zuora subscription plans and used in churn rate and LTV analysis.
attributes.references: Zuora Subscription Billing and Revenue; IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether GDPR data protection obligations apply to this platform based on its geographic availability and subscriber base. True = GDPR applies (EU/EEA territories served); False = GDPR not applicable. Governs consent management, data subject rights workflows, and Adobe Experience Platform profile handling.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3; European Audiovisual Observatory; Ofcom Broadcasting Standards

attributes.name: hdr_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the platform supports High Dynamic Range video delivery (HDR10, Dolby Vision, or HLG). True = HDR delivery supported; False = SDR only. Relevant for premium content licensing negotiations and CTV device compatibility.
attributes.references: ATSC 3.0; DVB Project Standards; ISO/IEC 14496 MPEG-4

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the OTT platform was officially made available to the public or target subscriber base. Used for platform age calculations, anniversary promotions, and regulatory reporting of service commencement.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Licensing; Ofcom Broadcasting Standards

attributes.name: max_concurrent_streams
attributes.description: The maximum number of simultaneous streams permitted per subscriber account on this platform. Enforced at the entitlement layer to prevent credential sharing and manage CDN bandwidth capacity. A key parameter in Zuora subscription plan configuration.
attributes.references: Zuora Subscription Billing Standards; IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: max_download_devices
attributes.description: The maximum number of devices on which a subscriber may store downloaded content for offline viewing on this platform. Null if offline downloads are not supported. Governed by DRM policy and Rightsline windowing rules.
attributes.references: Motion Picture Association (MPA) Content Protection Standards; Rightsline Rights Management

attributes.name: max_video_resolution
attributes.description: The highest video resolution tier supported for streaming on this platform. SD = Standard Definition (480p); HD = High Definition (720p); FHD = Full HD (1080p); 4K = Ultra HD (2160p); 8K = Super Hi-Vision (4320p). Drives ABR profile configuration, CDN bandwidth planning, and content ingest specifications in Dalet Galaxy.
attributes.references: ATSC 3.0; DVB Project Standards; ISO/IEC 14496 MPEG-4

attributes.name: mvpd_carriage_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Multichannel Video Programming Distributor (MVPD) Carriage Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this OTT platform's content or channels are eligible for carriage by MVPD or vMVPD partners (cable, satellite, virtual pay-TV operators). True = eligible for carriage agreements; False = direct-to-consumer only. Governs retransmission consent and must-carry negotiations.
attributes.references: FCC Retransmission Consent Rules; Ofcom Broadcasting Standards; IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: parent_brand
attributes.description: The overarching corporate or media brand under which this OTT platform operates (e.g., 'Media Broadcasting Group', 'MB Sports Network'). Supports brand hierarchy reporting, consolidated audience measurement, and multi-brand advertising sales in Salesforce Media Cloud.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: platform_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique code assigned to the OTT platform (e.g., 'MB_SVOD_WEB', 'MB_AVOD_CTV'). Used in operational systems, contracts, and partner integrations as the canonical platform identifier. Maps to the platform identifier used in Zuora subscription plans and Akamai CDN configuration.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards; Akamai CDN Platform Configuration

attributes.name: platform_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the platform's content offering, target audience, and service proposition. Used in partner onboarding documentation, regulatory filings, and internal product catalogues.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: platform_name
attributes.description: Official commercial brand name of the OTT platform as presented to subscribers and partners (e.g., 'MediaBroadcast+', 'MB Sports Live'). Used in marketing materials, EPG listings, and subscriber-facing interfaces.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: platform_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the OTT platform. 'active' = live and serving audiences; 'beta' = limited release for testing; 'sunset' = scheduled for decommission; 'suspended' = temporarily offline; 'inactive' = decommissioned. Governs whether the platform is eligible for new subscriber acquisition, ad campaign targeting, and CDN resource allocation.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards; FCC Broadcast Licensing

attributes.name: primary_streaming_protocol
attributes.description: The primary adaptive bitrate streaming protocol used for content delivery on this platform. HLS = HTTP Live Streaming (Apple standard, widely supported); MPEG-DASH = Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP (ISO 23009 standard); RTMP = Real-Time Messaging Protocol (legacy live); SRT = Secure Reliable Transport (low-latency live). Drives CDN configuration in Akamai and player SDK selection.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 23009 MPEG-DASH; ATSC 3.0; DVB Project Standards; Akamai CDN Configuration

attributes.name: service_tier
attributes.description: Business model classification of the OTT platform. SVOD = Subscription Video On Demand (recurring fee, no ads); AVOD = Advertising-Supported Video On Demand (free with ads); TVOD = Transactional Video On Demand (pay-per-view); FAST = Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television (linear-style free channel); HYBRID = combination of tiers. Drives revenue recognition logic in Zuora and ad inventory management in Wide Orbit.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); Zuora Revenue Recognition Standards

attributes.name: sla_uptime_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Uptime Target Percentage
attributes.description: The contractually committed platform availability target expressed as a percentage (e.g., 99.95). Governs CDN SLA enforcement with Akamai, incident escalation thresholds, and operational reporting. Distinct from actual measured uptime.
attributes.references: Akamai CDN SLA; SCTE Standards; IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: subscriber_count
attributes.description: Current count of active paying or registered subscribers on this platform as of the last reconciliation cycle. A key operational metric for ARPU calculation, churn rate monitoring, and Zuora revenue reporting. Confidential as it represents commercially sensitive business performance data.
attributes.references: Zuora Subscription Billing and Revenue; Nielsen Media Research; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: sunset_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date on which the OTT platform will be or was decommissioned. Null if the platform has no scheduled end-of-life. Used for subscriber migration planning, contract wind-down, and CDN resource deallocation.
attributes.references: Ofcom Broadcasting Standards; FCC Broadcast Licensing

attributes.name: supported_device_classes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of device categories supported by this platform (e.g., 'web,mobile,ctv,stb,gaming_console'). Drives device compatibility testing, app store distribution, and audience reach reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile|ctv|stb|gaming_console|smart_tv|tablet — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards; ATSC 3.0; DVB Project Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this OTT platform record was most recently modified. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver layer pipeline and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 8601

attributes.name: zuora_product_code
attributes.description: The product identifier in Zuora's subscription billing platform corresponding to this OTT platform's subscription offering. Used for revenue recognition, invoice generation, and subscription lifecycle management. Links the platform master record to Zuora's billing product catalogue.
attributes.references: Zuora Subscription Billing and Revenue; SOX Financial Reporting; SAP S/4HANA FI

products.name: device_type
products.description: Reference catalog of all device categories and models supported across OTT platforms — smart TVs, mobile phones, tablets, desktop browsers, streaming sticks, gaming consoles, and STBs. Captures device category, manufacturer, OS family, OS version range, screen resolution class, HDR capability, DRM compatibility (Widevine, PlayReady, FairPlay), ABR profile support, and certification status. Used for device-specific playback configuration and QoS segmentation.

attributes.name: device_type_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the device type record. Primary key.

attributes.name: abr_profile_dash
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device supports MPEG-DASH (Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP) adaptive bitrate streaming protocol.

attributes.name: abr_profile_hls
attributes.business_glossary_term: Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) Profile HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) Supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device supports HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) adaptive bitrate streaming protocol.

attributes.name: abr_profile_smooth
attributes.business_glossary_term: Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) Profile Smooth Streaming Supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device supports Microsoft Smooth Streaming adaptive bitrate protocol.

attributes.name: active_install_base
attributes.description: Estimated number of active devices of this type currently accessing the OTT platform, used for capacity planning and analytics.

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the device successfully completed OTT platform certification testing.

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the device certification expires and requires re-certification for continued platform support.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current certification status of the device for OTT platform compatibility (certified, pending, failed, not_tested).

attributes.name: codec_audio_support
attributes.description: List of audio codecs supported by the device (e.g., AAC, Dolby Digital, Dolby Atmos, DTS). Pipe-separated list.

attributes.name: codec_video_support
attributes.description: List of video codecs supported by the device (e.g., H.264, H.265/HEVC, VP9, AV1). Pipe-separated list.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 14496 MPEG-4, VP9, AV1 Codec Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this device type record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dai_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device supports DAI (Dynamic Ad Insertion) for server-side ad stitching in streaming content.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST), SCTE-35 Standards

attributes.name: device_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the device type (e.g., smart TV, mobile phone, tablet, desktop browser, streaming stick, gaming console, set-top box). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: smart_tv|mobile_phone|tablet|desktop_browser|streaming_stick|gaming_console|set_top_box — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: drm_fairplay_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device supports Apple FairPlay DRM for content protection.

attributes.name: drm_playready_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device supports Microsoft PlayReady DRM for content protection.

attributes.name: drm_widevine_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Digital Rights Management (DRM) Widevine Security Level
attributes.description: Google Widevine DRM security level supported (L1 = hardware-backed, L2 = software-backed, L3 = software only, not_supported).

attributes.name: form_factor
attributes.description: Physical form factor of the device (handheld, television, desktop, wearable, embedded).

attributes.name: hdr_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device supports HDR (High Dynamic Range) video playback for enhanced color and contrast.

attributes.name: hdr_format
attributes.description: Specific HDR formats supported by the device (e.g., HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, HLG). Pipe-separated list if multiple formats are supported.

attributes.name: input_method
attributes.description: Primary input method(s) supported by the device (e.g., touchscreen, remote_control, keyboard_mouse, voice, gamepad). Pipe-separated list if multiple.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this device type is currently active and supported for OTT platform streaming.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the device manufacturer or brand (e.g., Samsung, Apple, Roku, Amazon, LG, Sony).

attributes.name: max_bitrate_mbps
attributes.description: Maximum streaming bitrate supported by the device in megabits per second (Mbps), used for ABR profile selection and QoS (Quality of Service) optimization.

attributes.name: model_name
attributes.description: Specific model name or identifier assigned by the manufacturer (e.g., Galaxy S21, iPhone 13 Pro, Fire TV Stick 4K).

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Technical model number or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) used for precise device identification and inventory tracking.

attributes.name: network_capability
attributes.description: Network connectivity capabilities of the device (e.g., wifi, ethernet, cellular_4g, cellular_5g). Pipe-separated list if multiple.

attributes.name: os_family
attributes.description: Operating system family running on the device (e.g., Android, iOS, tvOS, webOS, Tizen, Roku OS, Fire OS, Windows, macOS, Linux, PlayStation, Xbox). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: android|ios|tvos|webos|tizen|roku_os|fire_os|windows|macos|linux|playstation|xbox — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: os_version_max
attributes.description: Maximum OS version tested and certified for compatibility. Null indicates no upper bound.

attributes.name: os_version_min
attributes.description: Minimum OS version required for OTT (Over-The-Top) platform compatibility and playback support.

attributes.name: qos_tier
attributes.description: QoS tier assigned to the device type for streaming quality segmentation and CDN (Content Delivery Network) routing (premium, standard, basic).

attributes.name: screen_resolution_class
attributes.description: Display resolution category supported by the device (SD, HD, Full HD, 4K UHD (Ultra High Definition), 8K UHD).

attributes.name: support_end_date
attributes.description: Date when platform support for this device type will be discontinued, after which playback may no longer be guaranteed.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this device type record was last modified.

attributes.name: user_agent_string
attributes.description: Standard HTTP user agent string reported by the device, used for device detection and analytics.

products.name: streaming_endpoint
products.description: Master record of all streaming origin and edge endpoints managed across the CDN infrastructure (Akamai CDN). Captures endpoint URL, CDN provider, PoP (Point of Presence) region, protocol (HLS, MPEG-DASH), ABR ladder configuration reference, DRM license server URL, token authentication scheme, geo-restriction rules, failover endpoint reference, SLA tier, and operational status. SSOT for the technical delivery address of each stream.

attributes.name: streaming_endpoint_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the streaming endpoint. Primary key for the streaming endpoint master record.

attributes.name: abr_profile_id

attributes.name: ssl_certificate_expiry_date

attributes.name: streaming_protocol

attributes.name: supported_devices

attributes.name: token_authentication_scheme

products.name: abr_profile
products.description: Defines Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) encoding ladder profiles used for multi-platform streaming delivery. Captures profile name, codec (H.264, H.265/HEVC, AV1, VP9), container format (fMP4, TS), rendition count, per-rendition bitrate/resolution/frame-rate specifications, audio codec and channel configuration, HDR/SDR flag, MPEG-DASH or HLS manifest template reference, and target device class. Governs the encoding farm (transcode) output specifications.
products.reference: ABR Encoding Ladder / MPEG-DASH ISO 23009 / HLS RFC 8216

attributes.name: abr_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ABR encoding ladder profile. Primary key.

attributes.name: format_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mediaasset.format_specification. Business justification: ABR profiles implement technical delivery standards (codec, bitrate ladder, resolution tiers) defined in format specifications. Broadcasters validate ABR configs against house specs for compliance. Qo

attributes.name: audio_bitrate_kbps
attributes.description: Audio bitrate in kilobits per second (e.g., 128, 192, 256). Defines audio quality.

attributes.name: audio_channel_config

attributes.name: audio_codec
attributes.description: Audio codec used for encoding (AAC, HE-AAC, AC-3/Dolby Digital, E-AC-3/Dolby Digital Plus, Opus).

attributes.name: cdn_optimization_flag

attributes.name: color_space
attributes.description: Color space standard used for encoding (BT.709 for HD, BT.2020 for UHD/HDR, DCI-P3 for cinema).

attributes.name: container_format
attributes.description: Media container format for the encoded segments (fMP4 for DASH, TS for HLS, MP4, WebM). Defines how video and audio streams are packaged.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ABR profile record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: drm_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the profile supports DRM encryption. True if DRM is enabled; false otherwise.

attributes.name: drm_system
attributes.description: DRM system(s) supported by this profile (Widevine, PlayReady, FairPlay Streaming, Multi-DRM). Null if DRM is not enabled.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the ABR profile became active and available for use in production encoding workflows.

attributes.name: encoding_preset

attributes.name: hdr_support_flag

attributes.name: keyframe_interval_seconds
attributes.description: Interval between keyframes (I-frames) in seconds. Aligns with segment duration for seamless ABR switching.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ABR profile record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: manifest_template_reference

attributes.name: max_bitrate_kbps
attributes.description: Highest video bitrate in kilobits per second across all renditions in the ladder. Used for high-quality streaming on fast connections.

attributes.name: max_resolution
attributes.description: Highest video resolution in the ladder (e.g., '1920x1080', '3840x2160'). Defines the top quality tier.

attributes.name: min_bitrate_kbps
attributes.description: Lowest video bitrate in kilobits per second across all renditions in the ladder. Used for low-bandwidth scenarios.

attributes.name: min_resolution
attributes.description: Lowest video resolution in the ladder (e.g., '320x180', '640x360'). Typically used for mobile or constrained bandwidth.

attributes.name: profile_code

attributes.name: profile_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the ABR profile, including use cases, target audience, and technical notes.

attributes.name: profile_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the ABR profile (e.g., 'Premium 4K HDR', 'Standard HD', 'Mobile Optimized').

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ABR profile. Active profiles are used in production encoding; deprecated profiles are phased out; testing profiles are under validation; inactive profiles are disabled.

attributes.name: qos_tier

attributes.name: rendition_count

attributes.name: segment_duration_seconds

attributes.name: streaming_protocol
attributes.description: Adaptive bitrate streaming protocol supported by this profile (HLS, MPEG-DASH, CMAF, Smooth Streaming).

attributes.name: target_device_class
attributes.description: Primary device class this profile is optimized for (mobile, tablet, desktop, smart TV, set-top box, gaming console). Influences resolution and bitrate choices.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the ABR profile. Incremented with each significant change to the encoding ladder or configuration.

attributes.name: video_codec
attributes.description: Primary video codec used for encoding (H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, AV1, VP9). Determines compression efficiency and device compatibility.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 14496-10 (H.264), ISO/IEC 23008-2 (HEVC), AV1 Bitstream & Decoding Process Specification

attributes.name: fill_rate_target_percentage

attributes.name: max_impressions_per_session

attributes.name: min_ad_pod_duration_seconds

Captures agreement type (retransmission consent, must-carry, voluntary carriage), retransmission consent terms, must-carry election status, carriage fee rates, channel positioning tiers, geographic coverage (authorized DMAs), exclusivity windows, holdback restrictions, compensation terms (cash, channel carriage, promotional commitments), contract effective/expiry dates, and negotiation history. Links to distribution partner and channel master. Distinct from rights licensing contracts owned by the rights domain.

attributes.name: channel_positioning_tier

attributes.name: drm_requirements
attributes.description: DRM and content protection requirements mandated under the agreement, such as encryption standards, conditional access systems, watermarking, and anti-piracy measures.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the carriage agreement becomes binding and the distribution partner is authorized to carry the channel or content package.

attributes.name: exclusivity_window

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the carriage agreement term ends. Nullable for open-ended or evergreen agreements subject to termination notice.

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction and governing law applicable to the agreement (e.g., State of New York, England and Wales). Determines which courts and laws apply in case of dispute.

attributes.name: holdback_restrictions
attributes.description: Restrictions on when or where content may be made available on other platforms or windows. Protects the distribution partners investment by limiting competing distribution during the agreement term.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amendment or modification to the carriage agreement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: minimum_subscriber_guarantee
attributes.description: Minimum number of subscribers the distribution partner guarantees to deliver for the channel. Used in per-subscriber fee calculations and performance commitments.

attributes.name: must_carry_election
attributes.description: Indicates whether the broadcaster has elected must-carry status under FCC rules, requiring the MVPD to carry the signal without negotiation. Applicable to qualified broadcast stations.

attributes.name: negotiation_history
attributes.description: Summary of key negotiation milestones, amendments, and material changes to the agreement over its lifecycle. Provides context for current terms and future renegotiations.

attributes.name: promotional_commitment
attributes.description: Marketing and promotional obligations agreed by either party, such as on-air promotion, co-marketing campaigns, EPG placement guarantees, or cross-platform promotion.

attributes.name: renewal_terms
attributes.description: Conditions and terms governing agreement renewal, including renewal period length, rate adjustments, renegotiation triggers, and notice requirements.

attributes.name: retransmission_consent_granted
attributes.description: Indicates whether retransmission consent has been granted under FCC regulations, authorizing the MVPD to rebroadcast over-the-air signals. Applicable only to retransmission consent agreement types.

attributes.name: service_level_agreement

attributes.name: technical_delivery_requirements

products.name: platform_device_certification
products.description: This association product represents the certification relationship between OTT platforms and device types. It captures the formal certification process that validates device compatibility with platform requirements, including DRM capabilities, resolution support, codec compatibility, and certification lifecycle management. Each record links one OTT platform to one device type with certification-specific attributes that exist only in the context of this platform-device pairing.. Existence Justification: In the OTT streaming industry, platform-device certification is a formal, operationally-managed business process where each OTT platform must independently certify each device type for compatibility. A single device type (e.g., Samsung Galaxy S21) must be certified separately for each platform it supports (e.g., Netflix, Disney+, HBO Max), and each platform maintains certification records for hundreds of device types. The certification relationship carries platform-specific data including certification dates, expiry dates, supported DRM levels, and maximum resolution for each unique platform-device pairing.

products.name: storage_location

products.name: asset_storage_assignment
products.description: Tracks the complete storage placement history for every media asset version — recording which file resides at which storage location, when it was placed there, and why it moved. products.name: collection_membership
products.description: This association product represents the membership relationship between asset_collection and media_asset. It captures the inclusion of individual media assets within editorial collections, series packages, news story bundles, and distribution packages. Each record links one asset_collection to one media_asset with attributes that define the role, sequence, and lifecycle of that specific membership relationship. Editorial teams actively create, reorder, and manage these memberships as part of content packaging and distribution workflows.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting operations, asset collections (series packages, news story bundles, film franchise collections, music albums) routinely contain multiple media assets, and individual assets frequently appear in multiple collections simultaneously—a raw interview clip may be part of a breaking news package, a documentary series collection, and an archival topic bundle. Editorial teams actively manage collection membership as a distinct operational activity, creating, reordering, and removing memberships with specific roles (primary/supplemental/bonus/trailer/promo), sequence positions, and inclusion dates. This is not an analytical correlation but a core content packaging workflow.

domains.name: rights
domains.description: Single source of truth for all intellectual property rights, licensing agreements, and royalty obligations. Manages content windows (theatrical, SVOD, AVOD, TVOD, linear), holdback periods, territory restrictions, talent residuals, music synchronization licenses, clearance workflows, and royalty calculations. Powered by Rightsline, this domain enforces windowing strategies and feeds availability data to scheduling and distribution.
domains.references: MPA Rights Management Guidelines, WIPO Copyright Treaty, Rightsline

products.name: license_agreement
products.description: Master record for all content licensing, acquisition, and syndication agreements managed in Rightsline. Captures the full contractual relationship between Media Broadcasting and rights grantors or licensees (studios, distributors, music publishers, talent guilds, syndication partners). Stores agreement type (acquisition, co-production, syndication, first-run syndication, off-network syndication, international syndication, music sync, output deal), licensor and licensee identities, effective and expiry dates, territory scope, exclusivity flags, total license fee, payment schedule with milestone detail (advances, minimum guarantees, per-episode fees, annual installments), run count limitations for syndication, governing law jurisdiction, and agreement status (draft, executed, expired, terminated). This is the SSOT for all rights-bearing contracts and the anchor entity for all downstream window, royalty, and clearance records.

products.name: rights_content_window
products.description: Defines the sequential release window strategy (windowing) for a specific content asset across exploitation platforms, and computes the net availability status. Each record captures the window type (theatrical, PVOD, TVOD, SVOD, AVOD, linear, FAST, home video, syndication), platform or channel scope, window open and close dates, holdback start and end dates, territory, exclusivity tier, and computed availability status (available, held-back, blacked-out, expired). Enforces the windowing hierarchy that prevents simultaneous exploitation across competing platforms. The net availability (considering holdbacks and blackouts) is refreshed whenever upstream rights or holdback records change. Directly consumed by scheduling and distribution domains to validate playout eligibility. Powered by Rightsline Windows module.

products.name: holdback
products.description: Records exclusivity holdback restrictions that prevent a content asset from being exploited on a specific platform, territory, or channel during a defined period. Each holdback captures the restriction type (platform holdback, territory holdback, channel holdback, format holdback), the restricted platform or distributor, holdback start and end dates, the triggering window type and source window reference, the source license agreement, and enforcement status (active, expired, waived, overridden). Holdbacks are enforced by the clearance workflow before any scheduling or distribution action is approved. Critical for MVPD carriage negotiations, OTT windowing compliance, and theatrical-to-home-video sequencing. Links to rights_content_window and license_agreement.

attributes.description: Indicates whether Dynamic Ad Insertion technology is enabled for this availability window, allowing server-side ad stitching into the content stream. True = DAI enabled, False = DAI not permitted.
attributes.references: SCTE (Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers) 35 Standard

attributes.name: download_to_own_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether permanent download (download-to-own, DTO) is permitted during this availability window. True = DTO allowed, False = streaming-only distribution.

attributes.name: drm_requirement
attributes.description: The level of Digital Rights Management protection required for this availability window. None = no DRM, Basic = minimal protection, Standard = industry-standard encryption, Premium = highest security level.

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this availability window record became effective and actionable for scheduling and distribution systems. May differ from computed_timestamp if there is a delay before activation.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this availability window grants exclusive distribution rights on the specified platform and territory. True = exclusive rights, False = non-exclusive rights.

attributes.name: expiration_notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether an expiration notification has been sent to scheduling and distribution systems alerting them that this availability window is approaching its end date. True = notification sent, False = not yet notified.

attributes.name: holdback_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days representing the holdback exclusivity period during which the content cannot be exploited on other platforms. Used to enforce windowing strategies.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code representing the primary language for which this availability window is licensed. Defines the audio/subtitle language requirement.

attributes.name: last_verified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this availability window was last verified against upstream rights and clearance records. Used for audit and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: max_resolution
attributes.description: The maximum video resolution permitted for distribution during this availability window. SD = Standard Definition (480p), HD = High Definition (720p), FHD = Full HD (1080p), UHD = Ultra HD (2160p), 4K = 4K resolution, 8K = 8K resolution.
attributes.references: ATSC (Advanced Television Systems Committee) A/53 Standard

attributes.name: minimum_guarantee_amount
attributes.description: The minimum guaranteed payment amount owed to the rights holder for this availability window, regardless of actual revenue performance. Expressed in the contract currency.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, exceptions, or special conditions related to this availability window. Used for documenting non-standard terms or manual overrides.

attributes.name: offline_viewing_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether temporary offline viewing (download for offline playback with expiration) is permitted during this availability window. True = offline viewing allowed, False = online streaming only.

attributes.name: platform_type
attributes.description: The distribution platform type for which this availability window applies. SVOD = Subscription Video On Demand, AVOD = Advertising-Supported Video On Demand, TVOD = Transactional Video On Demand, linear = traditional scheduled broadcasting, FAST = Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television, MVPD = Multichannel Video Programming Distributor.
attributes.references: IAB (Interactive Advertising Bureau) Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: royalty_rate_percent
attributes.description: The percentage royalty rate applicable to revenue generated during this availability window. Used for royalty calculations and residuals payments to rights holders and talent.

attributes.name: simulcast_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether simultaneous multi-platform broadcast (simulcast) is permitted during this availability window. True = simulcast allowed, False = platform-exclusive distribution only.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the upstream system or module that provided the source rights grant and window data used to compute this availability window. Typically Rightsline or a rights management platform.

attributes.name: streaming_protocol
attributes.description: The technical streaming protocol authorized for content delivery during this availability window. HLS = HTTP Live Streaming, MPEG-DASH = Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP, RTMP = Real-Time Messaging Protocol, smooth = Microsoft Smooth Streaming, progressive = progressive download.

attributes.name: subtitle_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates the subtitle or closed captioning requirement for this availability window. None = no subtitles required, Optional = subtitles available but not mandatory, Mandatory = subtitles must be provided, Closed_caption = closed captioning required for accessibility compliance.

attributes.name: syndication_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the content can be syndicated (resold to multiple outlets) during this availability window. True = syndication permitted, False = syndication prohibited.

attributes.name: window_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the availability window. Active = currently exploitable, Pending = future window not yet started, Expired = window has ended, Suspended = temporarily unavailable, Revoked = rights withdrawn, Extended = window duration increased.

products.name: holder
products.description: Master record for all external entities that hold intellectual property rights licensed to or from Media Broadcasting — including film studios, independent production companies, music publishers, performing rights organizations (PROs), talent guilds, record labels, news agencies, and individual creators. Captures rights holder name, entity type, ISAN or ISRC registrant identifier, primary contact, territory of incorporation, preferred currency, payment terms, and tax withholding classification. This is the SSOT for rights grantor and grantee identity within the rights domain, distinct from the partner domain which manages broader commercial relationships.
products.reference: ISAN; ISRC; PRO registry; Rightsline licensor master

attributes.name: holder_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the rights holder entity. Primary key for the rights holder master record.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id

attributes.name: partner_id

attributes.name: talent_profile_id

attributes.name: bank_account_name
attributes.description: Name on the bank account designated for royalty payments. Must match legal entity name for payment processing compliance.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number for royalty payment remittance. Encrypted at rest and in transit per PCI DSS requirements.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number

attributes.name: clearance_priority_level
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to clearance requests for content from this rights holder. VIP and critical levels receive accelerated processing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum credit exposure allowed for advance payments or minimum guarantees to this rights holder. Used for financial risk management.

attributes.name: default_royalty_rate

attributes.name: entity_type

attributes.name: exclusivity_preference
attributes.description: Rights holder's stated preference for exclusivity terms in licensing agreements. Influences windowing strategy and holdback negotiations.

attributes.name: guild_affiliation
attributes.description: Name of talent guild or performing rights organization (PRO) that this rights holder is affiliated with. Determines residual payment rules and reporting requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sag_aftra|wga|dga|afm|ascap|bmi|sesac|gema|prs|socan — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA, WGA, DGA, ASCAP, BMI, SESAC

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this rights holder record. Used for audit trail and change accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rights holder record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: minimum_guarantee_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum guarantee amount threshold below which this rights holder will not enter licensing agreements. Used for deal structuring and negotiation.

attributes.name: most_favored_nations_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rights holder has most favored nations clause requiring rate parity with other similar rights holders. True triggers rate comparison workflows.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special handling instructions, negotiation history, relationship nuances, or other contextual information for this rights holder.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred payment method for royalty disbursements. Determines processing fees and settlement timelines.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Standard payment terms in days from invoice date for royalty payments to this rights holder. Typical values include 30, 60, or 90 days net.

attributes.name: preferred_currency

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the rights holder contact. Used for contract notifications, clearance communications, and royalty statements.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the rights holder organization for licensing negotiations, clearance requests, and royalty inquiries.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the rights holder contact. Used for urgent clearance issues and contract negotiations.

attributes.name: registrant_identifier
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN) or International Standard Recording Code (ISRC) Registrant Identifier
attributes.description: The ISAN or ISRC registrant identifier assigned to the rights holder by the respective international registration authority. Used for global rights tracking and content identification.

attributes.name: relationship_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the business relationship with this rights holder was terminated or suspended. Null for active relationships.

attributes.name: relationship_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the business relationship with this rights holder was established. Used for historical reporting and relationship tenure analysis.

attributes.name: rights_holder_code
attributes.description: Internal business identifier code assigned to the rights holder for operational reference and system integration across Rightsline and billing systems.

attributes.name: rights_holder_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the rights holder entity as registered in their territory of incorporation. Used for contract execution and royalty payment identification.

attributes.name: rights_holder_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rights holder relationship. Active status is required for new license agreements and royalty payments.

attributes.name: royalty_calculation_method
attributes.description: Standard royalty calculation methodology applied to this rights holder's agreements. Determines how residuals and royalties are computed.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number for the rights holder in their jurisdiction of incorporation. Required for tax reporting and withholding compliance.

attributes.name: tax_withholding_classification
attributes.description: Tax withholding classification for royalty payments. Determines applicable withholding rates based on tax treaties and domestic regulations.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 515, OECD Model Tax Convention

attributes.name: tax_withholding_rate
attributes.description: Applicable tax withholding rate percentage for royalty payments to this rights holder. Derived from tax treaties and domestic law based on withholding classification.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 515, OECD Model Tax Convention

attributes.name: territory_of_incorporation
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the legal jurisdiction where the rights holder entity is incorporated or registered. Determines applicable tax treaties and withholding requirements.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created this rights holder record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

domains.name: subscriber

Manages subscriber profiles, household linkage, plan enrollment, authentication credentials, device registrations, viewing entitlements, parental controls, churn tracking, and ARPU/LTV metrics. Integrates with Zuora for subscription billing and Adobe Experience Platform for personalization. Enforces GDPR, CCPA, and COPPA compliance for subscriber data.

products.name: subscriber

Serves as the SSOT for subscriber identity, capturing registration source, registration timestamp, account status, service tier, demographic attributes, ARPU, LTV, churn risk score, GDPR/CCPA/COPPA consent flags, and integration keys to Zuora (billing) and Adobe Experience Platform (personalization). Each subscriber has a unique identity independent of household or device.
products.reference: Zuora Subscription Account / Adobe Experience Platform Profile

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the subscriber. Primary key for the subscriber master record across all service tiers (SVOD, AVOD, TVOD, bundled). System-generated surrogate key independent of household or device.

attributes.name: audience_profile_id

attributes.name: household_id

attributes.name: account_status

Active subscribers have full access; suspended accounts are temporarily blocked; cancelled accounts are terminated; trial accounts are in promotional period; churned accounts have completed cancellation.

attributes.name: adobe_profile_reference
attributes.description: External identifier linking this subscriber to their unified profile in Adobe Experience Platform. Used for personalization, segmentation, and journey orchestration.

attributes.name: arpu
attributes.description: Average monthly revenue generated by this subscriber across all revenue streams (subscription, transactional, advertising). Key metric for subscriber value assessment and segmentation.

attributes.name: billing_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency of subscription billing. Monthly, quarterly, and annual are recurring; lifetime is one-time payment; pay-per-view is transactional.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether California subscriber has opted out of personal data sale. Required for CCPA compliance.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when CCPA opt-out was recorded. Required for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: churn_risk_score
attributes.description: Predictive score (0.0000 to 1.0000) indicating likelihood of subscriber cancellation within next billing cycle. Generated by machine learning model based on engagement, payment history, and behavioral signals.

attributes.name: coppa_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this subscriber account is subject to COPPA restrictions (under 13 years old). When true, data collection and advertising are restricted.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing subscriber's primary geographic location. Used for content rights windowing, regional pricing, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this subscriber record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Subscriber's date of birth. Used for age verification, parental controls, COPPA compliance, and demographic segmentation.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for subscriber communication, authentication, and personalization. Used as primary contact channel and login credential.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: External business identifier for the subscriber, typically used for integration with Zuora billing and Adobe Experience Platform. May be customer-facing account number or external system key.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Subscriber's given name as provided during registration. Used for personalization and customer service interactions.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether subscriber has provided explicit consent for data processing under GDPR. Required for EU subscribers.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when GDPR consent was obtained. Required for audit trail and consent management.

attributes.name: gender

attributes.name: last_login_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of subscriber's most recent authentication. Used for engagement tracking and churn prediction.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Subscriber's family name as provided during registration. Used for personalization and customer service interactions.

attributes.name: last_viewing_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of subscriber's most recent content viewing session. Used for engagement analysis and retention modeling.

attributes.name: ltv
attributes.description: Predicted total revenue this subscriber will generate over their entire relationship with the service. Used for acquisition cost justification and retention prioritization.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether subscriber has consented to receive marketing communications. Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance.

attributes.name: max_concurrent_streams
attributes.description: Maximum number of simultaneous video streams allowed for this subscriber based on their service tier. Enforced by playout and CDN systems.

attributes.name: max_registered_devices

attributes.name: parental_control_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether parental controls are active on this subscriber account. When true, content access is restricted based on rating thresholds and PIN protection.

attributes.name: parental_control_pin

attributes.name: phone_number

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Subscriber's postal or ZIP code. Used for geographic segmentation, local content recommendations, and blackout enforcement.

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO language code representing subscriber's preferred interface and content language. Used for UI localization and content recommendations.

attributes.name: registration_source
attributes.description: Channel through which the subscriber originally registered. Used for acquisition analytics and channel effectiveness measurement.

attributes.name: registration_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the subscriber account was first created. Used for cohort analysis, LTV calculation, and subscriber lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: service_tier
attributes.description: Current subscription service tier. SVOD (Subscription Video On Demand) includes basic and premium tiers; AVOD (Advertising-Supported Video On Demand) is free with ads; TVOD (Transactional Video On Demand) is pay-per-view; bundle includes multiple services.

attributes.name: subscription_end_date

attributes.name: subscription_start_date

attributes.name: total_viewing_hours

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this subscriber record was last modified. Used for change tracking and incremental processing.

attributes.name: zuora_account_reference
attributes.description: External identifier linking this subscriber to their billing account in Zuora subscription management system. Used for payment processing and revenue recognition integration.

attributes.name: content_language_restriction

attributes.name: coppa_child_profile_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether this parental control configuration restricts viewing to specific registered devices. True if device restrictions are enforced, False if profile can be accessed from any device.

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this parental control configuration expires or is scheduled to be deactivated. Null if no expiration is set.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Flag

attributes.name: last_modified_by

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: maturity_level_override

attributes.name: max_daily_viewing_minutes
attributes.description: Maximum number of minutes of content viewing allowed per day for this profile. Null if no daily limit is set. Used to enforce screen time limits for child profiles.

attributes.name: notification_email
attributes.description: Email address to which parental control alerts and notifications are sent (e.g., when a child attempts to access restricted content). Null if notifications are disabled.

attributes.name: parental_control_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this parental control configuration. Active indicates the configuration is enforced; Inactive indicates it is saved but not enforced; Suspended indicates temporary deactivation by system or admin.

attributes.name: pin_code_hash

attributes.name: pin_protection_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether a PIN is required to access content above the rating threshold or to modify parental control settings. True if PIN protection is active, False otherwise.

attributes.name: purchase_lock_enabled

attributes.name: search_restriction_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether search functionality is restricted to only show age-appropriate content. True if search results are filtered by parental controls, False if unrestricted search is allowed.

attributes.name: viewing_time_restriction_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether time-of-day viewing restrictions are enforced for this profile. True if time restrictions are active, False otherwise.

attributes.name: applied_discount_amount
attributes.description: The total discount amount applied to the new plan as part of this change. Includes promotional offers, retention discounts, and loyalty rewards.

attributes.name: applied_discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied to the new plan subscription fee. Used for promotion effectiveness analysis and revenue impact modeling.

attributes.name: auto_renew_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic renewal is enabled for the subscription after this change. Critical for churn prediction and renewal revenue forecasting.

attributes.name: change_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the subscription change was initiated. Enables channel effectiveness analysis and self-service adoption tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile app|call center|chat|email|api|admin portal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: change_effective_date
attributes.description: The date when the subscription change became effective and billing adjustments were applied. Critical for revenue recognition and proration calculations.

attributes.name: change_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the agent or system during the change process. Captures context, customer feedback, and special handling instructions.

attributes.name: change_processed_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the system completed processing the change and updated the subscription state. Used for operational efficiency metrics.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: The primary reason provided or inferred for the subscription change. Critical for churn analysis, retention strategy, and product improvement.
attributes.value_regex: customer request|price increase|content preference|financial hardship|technical issue|retention offer

attributes.name: change_request_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the subscriber or agent initiated the change request. Used for time-to-fulfillment analysis and customer experience tracking.

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: The type of change applied to the subscription. Categorizes the nature of the modification for lifecycle analysis and revenue impact assessment.

attributes.name: content_entitlement_change
attributes.description: Describes changes to content library access, premium channel entitlements, or windowing rights resulting from this subscription change. Critical for content licensing and rights management.

attributes.name: contract_term_months
attributes.description: The length of the new subscription contract term in months resulting from this change. Used for commitment analysis and churn risk modeling.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this subscription change record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: device_limit_new
attributes.description: The maximum number of concurrent devices allowed under the new subscription plan. Enables analysis of device limit impact on upgrade and downgrade decisions.

attributes.name: device_limit_previous
attributes.description: The maximum number of concurrent devices allowed under the previous subscription plan. Used to track device entitlement changes and household sharing patterns.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this subscription change record was last updated in the data platform. Supports change data capture and incremental processing workflows.

attributes.name: mrr_impact_amount
attributes.description: The net change in monthly recurring revenue resulting from this subscription change. Positive for upgrades, negative for downgrades. Calculated as new_monthly_recurring_revenue minus previous_monthly_recurring_revenue.

attributes.name: new_billing_period
attributes.description: The billing frequency of the new subscription plan. Enables analysis of billing period changes and their impact on cash flow and retention.

attributes.name: new_monthly_recurring_revenue
attributes.description: The monthly recurring revenue amount from the new plan after this change. Used to calculate MRR expansion, contraction, and net revenue retention metrics.

attributes.name: previous_billing_period
attributes.description: The billing frequency of the previous subscription plan. Used to analyze billing period migration patterns and payment preference trends.

attributes.name: previous_monthly_recurring_revenue
attributes.description: The monthly recurring revenue amount from the previous plan before this change. Critical for MRR movement analysis and revenue waterfall reporting.

attributes.name: proration_amount
attributes.description: The prorated credit or charge amount applied to the subscriber account due to mid-cycle plan changes. Positive values represent charges, negative values represent credits.

attributes.name: proration_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the proration amount. Supports multi-currency subscription operations.

attributes.name: service_tier_change
attributes.description: Describes the service tier transition for this subscription change. Specific to media streaming business models including AVOD (Advertising-Supported Video On Demand), SVOD (Subscription Video On Demand), and tiered SVOD offerings.
attributes.value_regex: AVOD to SVOD|SVOD to AVOD|SVOD Basic to Premium|Premium to Basic|no tier change

attributes.name: zuora_amendment_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the Zuora subscription amendment record that represents this change. Enables reconciliation with the billing system of record.

products.name: payment_instrument
products.description: Subscriber's stored payment instruments used for subscription billing. Captures payment method type (credit card, debit card, PayPal, direct debit, gift card, MVPD billing), masked card/account number, card brand, expiry date, billing address, is_default flag, and PCI DSS tokenization reference. Managed in Zuora as the payment method entity. Distinct from actual payment transactions owned by the billing domain.
products.reference: Zuora Payment Method / PCI DSS Token

attributes.name: payment_instrument_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment instrument record. Primary key.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
